lokele: Lokasa loa lotango loa fɛtɔ ya bangau ba Yesu Masiya, wana wa Dawidi, wana wa Abalayama.
english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, 1:1 the son of David, the son of Abraham.

lokele: Abalayama loota Yisaka; Yisaka loota Yakobo; Yakobo loota Yuda la bitungani yande;
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

lokele: Yuda loota Pelese la Shela ko la Tamala; Pelese loota Eselone; Eselone loota Lama;
english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

lokele: Lama loota Aminadaba; Aminadaba loota Nasona; Nasona loota Salamona;
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

lokele: Salamona loota Boasha ko la Laba; Boasha loota Obede ko la Luta;
english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

lokele: Obede loota Yese; Yese loota Dawidi ako Bɔkɔta. Dawidi ako Bɔkɔta loota Solomo ko la lotika loa Uliya;
english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king 1:6 became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

lokele: Solomo loota Labama; Labama loota Abiya; Abiya loota Asa;
english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

lokele: Asa loota Yosopata; Yosopata loota Yotama; Yotama loota Aasha;
english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

lokele: Aasha loota Esikiya;
english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

lokele: Esikiya loota Manase; Manase loota Amona; Amona loota Yosiya;
english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

lokele: Yosiya loota Yekoniya la bitungani yande nda baunjwelo konda Babilona.
english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

lokele: La mbisa ya baunjwelo nda Babilona, Yekoniya loota Salatiele; Salatiele loota Shelubabela;
english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

lokele: Shelubabela loota Abiuda; Abiuda loota Eliyakima; Eliyakima loota Ashula;
english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

lokele: Ashula loota Sadoka; Sadoka loota Akima; Akima loota Eleyuda;
english: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

lokele: Eleyuda loota Eleasha; Eleasha loota Matana; Matana loota Yakobo;
english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

lokele: Yakobo loota Yosefa ako bolome wa Malia, nyango wa Yesu oyasotangomo mbo Masiya.
english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, 1:16 who is called Christ.

lokele: Ongoma fɛtɔ bitotina ko ende Abalayama ko ende Dawidi yende fɛtɔ liu la inɛi, la ende Dawidi ko nda baunjwelo nda Babilona bende fɛtɔ liu la inɛi, la konda baunjwelo nda Babilona ko nda lootomu loa Masiya bende fɛtɔ liu la inɛi. Liotomu lia Yesu
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

lokele: Liotomu lia Yesu Masiya liaka ngo ko ani— Nyango wande ako Malia aaka liäla lia Yosefa, kongo ko oso wa lisɔngɔni liau, Malia lɔɛnɛnɛ la lieme ko la Bolimo Botanu.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Yosefa, olome wande, eoka aaka oto wa liengani, la atialɛmbɛkɛ ndochambola inde fololo, inde losanga oola liäla wisakumbo.
english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

lokele: Aenyelaka Yosefa loasɔ-lo, futuku bokitomo wa Mungu lɔɛnɛlɛ end’inde ko la saki, inde mbo— Yosefa wana wa Dawidi, owangëke ndɔsɔ Malia wali waɛ, eoka lisɔlɛ elisotol’inde lile ko elia Bolimo Botanu.
english: But when he thought about these things, behold, 1:20 an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Eotaka nde wana otolome, bofak’inde lina liko Yesu eoka end’Inde oyatouwesa bato bande nda njasɔ ibe yau.
english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, 1:21 for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

lokele: Ebi bitotina yaaka litina mbo eyaongömökö la Ngɛnɛ ko la Bɔtɔndɔli bikɔchɔmɔkɔ, biko mbo—
english: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

lokele: Tɛnɛngo boseka nd’atoaelo lieme, la atoota nde wana otolome, Inde efomoko lina liko Emanwele (litina mbo Mungu ale lasu).
english: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.” Isaiah 7:14

lokele: Limɔ Yosefa loemala yai nda ilɔ, inde lokela kwani akangesaka bokitomo wa Ngɛnɛ ekanges’inde, inde loiyesa Malia wali wande.
english: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

lokele: Kongo ko atiaingaläkä lande oso ani atitaote wana otolome. Inde lota wana lina liko Yesu.
english: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

lokele: Aotomökö Yesu nda Betelehemu wa Yudea nda mbile eyaaka Helodi Bɔkɔta, limɔ Bakesa ya tolonge ebasekwaka fangi ya batɛmwɛlɔ-ba-bonyanya, iyo loya nda Yelusaleme, iyo lofelaka mbo—
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men 2:1 from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

lokele: ¿Oyaotomu kwani Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda ende anima? Eoka tosɔɛnɛ ilonge shande nda fangi ya batɛmwɛlɔ-ba-bonyanya la tosoya oyatulamel’Inde se.
english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

lokele: Okaka Helodi ongoma inde lɔɛnɛ tale finɛ la bato batotina ba Yelusaleme lisanga.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

lokele: Inde losɔngɔmɛsɛkɛ kanga ebieti la Batikasa ba bato, inde lofelak’iyo elela eyetootomo Masiya.
english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

lokele: Iyo mbo— Nda Betelehemu wa Yudea, eoka loatomoko kola Bɔtɔndɔli mbo—
english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

lokele: Aɛ Betelehemu nda yese ya Yudea Oti ango esikɛkɛ sha benyafala ya Yudea Eoka Bɔkɔta nd’atotsmwa end’aɛ Oyatoyala Botingani wa bato bami bako BaIsalaele.
english: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’” Micah 5:2

lokele: Lamao Helodi lota eBakesa lioi wisisa la inde loluwesomo lau mbile eyɛnɛlɛkɛ ilonge,
english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

lokele: inde lotom’iyo mbo baɛkɛ ko nda Betelehemu, inde mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okakɔtɔlɔkɔ loasɔ loa wana la wɛlï, akɛnɛkɛ ino wɛnɛ Inde, ino koeshela’mi wɛndi mbo iyeke oyasemol’Inde.
english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

lokele: Okaka’iyo baoi ba Bɔkɔta, iyo lɔkɛ limɔ ilonge esiɛnɛk’iyo nda batɛmwɛlɔ, shao lɔkɛ oso wau konda elela olo ayali Wana.
english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ iyo ilonge iyo looka limɛngɔ finɛ fafo.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

lokele: Iyo lɔkɛ konda ndakɔ, iyo lɔɛnɛ Wana amamwito la Malia nyango wande, iyo lokwa se, iyo losemokola Inde, limɔ iyo loliola bondanda wau, iyo lotambel’Inde bafaefi bau, bako bieto ya loketi lofi, la mwɛmwɛ ya Libano la mola. Eko yeka ya liese lia loketi lofi
english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

lokele: Kongo ko iyo loimomo nda saki mbo batainywa ende Helodi, eokao iyo lotangwa nda yese yau ko la mboka yasi. Botili nda Ejipeto
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

lokele: Asilak’iyo ndotangwa eyau, bokitomo wa Mungu lɔɛnɛlɛ ende Yosefa nda saki, inde mbo— Emalaka, ilaka Wana la nyango wande, kwaka otili konda Ejipeto, yalakaka omao kond’akaesheleke Imi eshel’aɛ wɛndi, eoka Helodi asosanga okaluka Wana mbo asɛɛsɛlɛsɛkɛ Inde.
english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

lokele: Lamao Yosefa loemala, inde loila Wana la nyango la ocho, inde lɔkɛ nda Ejipeto.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

lokele: Inde loyalaka omao konda bawelo ba Helodi, litina mbo bina eyaongaka Ngɛnɛ ko la Bɔtɔndɔli bikɔchɔmɔkɔ, mbo— Isota Wana wami lioi mbo asekweke nda Ejipeto.
english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.” Hosea 11:1

lokele: Lamao ɛnɛkɛ Helodi mbo asolimbomo kola Bakesa, inde losomaka finɛ, inde lotoma basilikani nda Betelehemu la nda kenge bitimbi mbo baoleke bana batolome atotina ebatitaengane miaka imbale ko nda mbile eyaluwesomoko inde la eBakesa.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

lokele: Lamao baoi ebaongaka Yelemaya ewa Bɔtɔndɔli bakɔchɔmɔkɔ, mbo—
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

lokele: Limiki losookana nda Lama, Bileli la bitondo ya kelelikeleli, Ende Laele oyasoleela bana bande, Atilɛmbɛ liɔnjɔnji eoka bana bat’imɔ.
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.” Jeremiah 31:15

lokele: Awaka Helodi, Bokitomo wa Ngɛnɛ lɔɛnɛlɛ ende Yosefa nda Ejipeto nda saki,
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

lokele: inde mbo-Siswaka, ilaka Wana la nyango wande, kɛndɛkɛ nda yese ya Isalaele, eoka ebakotaka ndoola Wana, iyo basowa.
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

lokele: Inde losiswa, inde loila Wana la nyango wande, inde loiya nda yese ya Isalaele.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

lokele: Nde ökakä inde mbo Alakelau atokakalesa Yudea nda lifa lia Helodi sango wande, inde lowanga ɔkɛ omao, limɔ eoka mbo asokangesomo la Mungu nda saki,
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

lokele: inde lɔkɛ okayala nda bokenge boko Nasaleta, l’ani baoi ebaongaka Batɔndɔli bakɔchɔmɔkɔ mbo— Inde atotangomo ewa Nasalene.
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

lokele: Nda bacho bana Yoane Bolufi loya oyanangolaka nda liɔmbɛlɛ lia Yudea, inde mbo—
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

lokele: Kalanganaka, eoka Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosoya tina.
english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

lokele: Ende Inde oyaongomoko la Bɔtɔndɔli ako Yesaya, mbo— Limiki litoamama nda liɔmbɛlɛ mbo— Komyaka mboka ya Ngɛnɛ, Longamesaka biëli yande.
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!” Isaiah 40:3

lokele: Yoane-yo awataka esinda ya fuu ya ngamela, la bɔkɔli wa lokofo loa nyama nda lɔtɛta la alakäkä bakelele la wee wa lokonda.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

lokele: Bato ba Yelusaleme wike la batotina ba Yudea la eba kenge bitotina ya Yaladene,
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

lokele: balufiomökö lande nda liyande lia Yaledene ani batoaokola njasɔ ibe yau.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛk’inde wike wa BaFalusi la BaSandoke batoyaka end’inde ndoyalufiomo, inde loonga lau mbo— Ino lioti lia njɔ; ¿Ndai asokambes’ino mbo bokweke otili bosekwa nda efango eyekayeke?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

lokele: Eokao biyaelo yanu bienganeke la likalangani lianu.
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

lokele: Wenyelëke oyaongana mbo— Abalayama ende ngau wasu, eoka itoonga lanu mbo Mungu asokɔkɔlɔ ko la batalɛ-ba kongo ndoemesela Abalayama bana.
english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

lokele: Kwani shondo sisotomo oko nda biili ya tosandu la isandu la isandu esiitoota tuma tolau, shao kotindomo, shao koumbolomo nda bösä.
english: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

lokele: Imi nd’asolufia ino nda balia eoka ya likalangani, kongoko oyatoya liili liami asoeta’mi la bofoka. Itiengane ango ndotola tokwaka twande; Inde elufiaka ino la Bolimo Botanu la bösä.
english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit. 3:11

lokele: Lüngu loande lole nda bosamba wande mbo afɛfɛkɛ bofonga; atɔɔmbɔ ɛfɛfyɛlɔ tanelele, atosɔnjaka befonga nda ekukyelo yande, kongo ko atofechaka mboso nda bösä wa loiloi ebotilatiamëkë.
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu losekwa nda Ngalilai, ndokakɛ ende Yoane nda Yaledene okalufiomo lande.
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan 3:13 to John, to be baptized by him.

lokele: Nde Yoane lokota ndokufesa Yesu, inde mbo— Imi nd’ale la boeno wolufiomo laɛ, nde osoya ende’mi?
english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Lɛmbɛlɛkɛ Imi kwani, eoka lole lasu mbo tokɔcheke bitotina ya liengani ongoma. Lamao Yoane lolɛmbɛlɛ Yesu.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lolufiomo; aeswäkä Inde nda balia, lisasaya buse loliolomo la Inde lɔɛnɛ Bolimo wa Mungu botoaa se kwa ekükü, bosotalema ende Inde, la limiki lookana nda use mbo— Oyo ende Wana bosamomu wami oyatoomalesa’mi finɛ.
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

lokele: Lamao Yesu lɔkɛsɔmɔ la Bolimo ko nda liɔmbɛlɛ okasoshelomo la Satana.
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

lokele: Omao Inde lokila bieka ko bacho kama inɛi, la löwa la ocho, lamao Inde looka isiyɛ.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

lokele: Ayaka Bososheli ende Inde, inde mbo— Eya to mbo wende Wana wa Mungu ongaka to mbo e-batalɛ-ba bakinjweke beila.
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Losotomo nda lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Boto aitoyalaka la liwawi ko l’eoka ya beila kongo, Kangä eoka ya lioi la lioi elitokuswa nda bɔnɔkɔ wa Mungu.
english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’” Deuteronomy 8:3

lokele: Limɔ Bososheli lɔkɛsɛ Inde ko nda bokenge ewuchomu boko Yelusaleme inde loemes’Inde olikolo lia losambɔ loa ndakɔ ya Mungu,
english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

lokele: inde loonga lande mbo— Eya to mbo wende Wana wa Mungu, kushaka bindo yaɛ se, eoka losotomo nda lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Atoonga la bakitomo bande mbo batinganeke laɛ La batotolak’Aɛ nda besamba yau mbo Otaomana litindi liaɛ nda litalɛ.
english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’” Psalms 91:11-12

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Ko ongoma losotomo nda Lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Ososhelëke Ngɛnɛ Mungu waɛ.
english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’” Deuteronomy 6:16

lokele: Liasi Satana lɔkɛsɛ Inde amamwito lande olikolo lia löngo lofi fafo, omao inde lɔɛnɛs’Inde yakakaelo bitotina ya wenda la bɛfɛkɔ ya yao,
english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

lokele: inde mbo— Botulamela’mi se ndosemola’mi imi kofaef’Aɛ ebi bitotina.
english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lande mbo— Kɛndɛ, Satana, eoka losotomo nda Lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Tulamelaka ngo ko Mungu waɛ se, Semolaka ko Inde kongo.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, 4:10 Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’” Deuteronomy 6:13

lokele: Lamao Satana lomach’Inde, la bakitomo ba Mungu loyakukya Inde.
english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

lokele: Okäkä nde Yesu mbo Yoane akandomökö nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, Inde lɔkɛ nda Ngalilai,
english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

lokele: limɔ Inde losekwa nda Nasaleta, Inde lokayalaka nda Kafenauma bokenge ebole tina la eliya nda biese ya Sebulona la Nafatali,
english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

lokele: mbo baoi ebaongäkä bɔtɔndɔli ako Yesaya bakɔchɔmɔkɔ, mbo—
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

lokele: Yese ya Sebulona la yese ya Nafatali, Mboka ya eliya, faki yasi ya Yaledene, Ngalilai eyele yese ya ebati BaYuda,
english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

lokele: Bato ebayalaka nda lilima basɔɛnɛ liangangi lifi. Ebayalaka nda elele ya liɔmbɛ lia liwa Liangangi lisoangangel’iyo. Lotomo lioi loa Baeki ba Oso
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.” Isaiah 9:1-2

lokele: Ko nda mbile ena Yesu loakola ndonangola mbo— Kalanganaka eoka Bɔkɔta wa Use bosoya tina.
english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

lokele: Akɛndɛ̈kɛ̈ Yesu nda ngɔngɛ ya Eliya ya Ngalilai Inde lɔɛnɛ bato ambale, boloo la etungani, bako Simona, oyatangomökö imɔ ko Petelo, la Andelo, ani batoluwä wɛngɔ eoka baaka baluwi ba swi.
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he 4:18 saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Tütaka’mi la itoyales’inö baluwi ba bato.
english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

lokele: Lisasaya iyo lomacha wɛngɔ wau, iyo lotüta Inde.
english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

lokele: Akɛndɛ̈kɛ̈ Inde sumbu liasi, Inde lɔɛnɛ batolome basi ambale, bako Yakobo wana wa Sebedayo la Yoane, etungani yande nda watɔ amamwito la sango wau ako Sebedayo, ani batowamba wɛngɔ wau; Yesu lot’iyo lioi.
english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

lokele: Kwamao iyo lomacha watɔ la sango wau, iyo lotüt’Inde.
english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

lokele: Yesu akɛndɛ̈kɛ̈ nda yese etotina ya Ngalilai, okaekese nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ yau; Inde lokanangokole Mboli Ilau ya Bɔkɔta; Inde losäsesa eba kambo la eba biale ya bɔfɔɔnɔ la bɔfɔɔnɔ ebiayaläkä la bato omao.
english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

lokele: Lokuku loande lookana nda yese etotina ya Sulia, iyo loeshekel’Inde batotina ba kambo l’ebayaläkä la ngwo la bemusi ya bɛfɔnɔ wike, l’eba belimo ibe, l’eba tosekakɔkɔ, l’eba lonyango, la Inde losäsekes’iyo.
english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

lokele: Biindi ya bato lotütak’Inde, bato ebasekwäkä nda Ngalilai la Dekapoli la nda Yelusaleme la faki owale wa Yaledene.
english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

lokele: Ɛ̈nɛkɛ̈ Yesu biindi ya bato, Inde lolila nda löngo limɔ,
english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

lokele: ayalaka Inde se, baeki bande loya end’Inde la Inde loakola ndoonga lau la Inde loekes’iyo mbo—
english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’eba touwe nda betema yau, eoka Bɔkɔta wa Use bole lau.
english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. Isaiah 57:15

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’ebatolela ndeli, eoka batɔɔnjɔnjɔmɔkɔ.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted. Isaiah 61:2

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’eba bɔfɔu eoka batosangola wenda botiko.
english: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth. 5:5 Psalms 37:11

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’eba yɛmɛ la isiyɛ sha njasɔ ya liengani, eoka batokanelo.
english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’eba shota, eoka batowɛlɔmɔ shota ko la bato basi.
english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’eba betema betanu, eoka batɔɛnɛ Mungu.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’ebatɔɔngɛsɛ njasɔ eoka batotangomo bana ba Mungu.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile l’ebasokongolomo eoka ya liengani, eoka Bɔkɔta wa Use bole lau.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

lokele: Limɛngɔ lile lanu imɔ ani akamɔlɛkɛ bato ɛmɔlɔkɔ ino, l’ani akakongoleke iyo ekongokol’ino l’ani batotɔ̈ngɔ ino la lolanga ko l’eoka yami.
english: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

lokele: Okaka to limɛngɔ la omakalaka eoka bondanda wanu wende ofi nda use. Bakongokolaka batɔndɔli ebaaka oso wanu ko ongoma.
english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

lokele: Ino wende bokwa wa wenda; nde eyambo bokwa botemba shokana imɔ shao kookana liasi l’iye? Botiengane imɔ ndokela la yeka, kangä ndokushomo tungi bomatekelomoko la batindi ba bato.
english: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

lokele: Ino wende liangangi lia wenda; bokenge eboswomu likolo lia löngo angokɔkɔlɔ ndoisomo.
english: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

lokele: Atoanesa bato taka baitokasɛlɛ yao ose ya mbutɛ, kangä nda etalielo la yao koangangekela bato batotina nda ndakɔ.
english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

lokele: Liangangi lianu liangangeleke bato mbo bɛnɛkɛ bolau wa bekeeli yanu la mbo baomaleseke Sango wanu oyayali nda use.
english: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

lokele: Oenyelëke mbo isoyatungesa Bikela la Baoi ba Batɔndɔli; itiye ndoyasilesa yao, kangä ndoyakɔchaka yao.
english: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

lokele: Wewe, isoonga lanu mbo— Ko nda mbile eyekawanjweke use la se, angwɛnɛ ango lioi ango itɔitɔni sha lioi lia Bikela ya Mungu nde kowanjwa, sakolo ngo ko bitotina bilakɔchɔmɔkɔ fɛɛ.
english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter 5:18 or one tiny pen stroke 5:18 shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

lokele: Eokao boto oyatosɔmbɔlɔ ekela ɛmɔi ɛkɛkɛ nda yao, ango oyatoekesa bato otefola yao, botoyo etangomoko bokɛkɛ fafo nda Bɔkɔta wa Use; nde oyatolitesa yao la oyatoekesa yao, inde etangomoko ofi nda Bɔkɔta wa Use.
english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

lokele: Im’itoonga lanu mbo— Sakolo ko liengani lianu litolongela elia Batikasa la BaFalusi, ani ino angɔɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Use. Efango
english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

lokele: Osooka mbo bangau baongomökö mbo— Wolëke oto la yɛnɔ, la imɔ mbo oyatoola oto la yɛnɔ, eyalaka nde la loasɔ ende Bokumi;
english: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ Exodus 20:13 and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

lokele: nde Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo boto oyasosoma la wina lisomela, inde eyalaka la loasɔ ende Bokumi. Boto oyatoonga la wina mbo— Aɛ ebebe, eyalaka la loasɔ ende eb’ikumbɛ, la oyatoonga mbo— Aɛ wende itume, inde eyalaka nde la loasɔ lɔkɛs’inde nda Ngehena ya bösä.
english: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause 5:22 will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ 5:22 will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna. 5:22

lokele: Eokao eyambo ototamba lifaefi liaɛ nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, lamao boenyela mbo wina ale l’aɛ la loasɔ,
english: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

lokele: tamachaka lifaefi liaɛ oso wa etambelo, takɛndɛkɛ okakomyana loasɔ mbo oyaleke lande lisaɔ liasi, limɔ otoyatamba lifaefi liaɛ.
english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

lokele: Ɔngɛsɛ botema wa oto oyatɔkɛ laɛ ende Bokumi ani okoyala nda mboka, mbo atakɛsɛ aɛ ende juge; limɔ juge kokɛsɛ aɛ ende Botingani wa bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, l’aɛ kotomo omao nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

lokele: Isoonga laɛ wewe mbo aɛ otiasekwe omao ko nd’akakambeke aɛ bitotina fɛɛ, angotikala ango sɛngi. Bolëfë
english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny. 5:26

lokele: Osooka mbo loaongomökö mbo— Otwëke nyongo;
english: “You have heard that it was said, 5:27 ‘You shall not commit adultery;’ Exodus 20:14

lokele: nde Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo— Boto oyatoticha otomali ko ndookel’inde bolëfë, asosila oko ndotwa lande nyongo nda botema.
english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

lokele: Liso liaɛ lia olome likwes’aɛ nda obe ɔ̈mɔlɔkɔ liao, eoka losoeta la olau mbo elengo yaɛ ɛmɔi eweke, inga mbo bindo yaɛ itotina biumbolomoko nda Ngehena ya bösä.
english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna. 5:29

lokele: Bosamba waɛ w’olome bokwes’aɛ nda obe, tenaka wao, umbolaka wao tungi, eoka losoeta la olau end’aɛ mbo elengo ɛmwito eweke, inga mbo bindo yaɛ itotina biumbolomoko nda Ngehena. Lisokoli lia Wali
english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna. 5:30

lokele: Loatomökö ekela mbo— Boto esokola wali wande, afek’inde lokasa loluwesa mbo liyäla lisowa.
english: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’ Deuteronomy 24:1

lokele: Nde Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo— Boto oyasosokola wali sakolo ko loasɔ loa nyongo, asokɛsɛ wali nda nyongo la boto ona oyatosɔngo wali ona oyasosokolomo, inde imɔ asotwa nyongo. Ekanɔ
english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

lokele: Liasi imɔ, osooka mbo bangau baongaka mbo— Otinyëke ekano litinyela nde kɔchaka bikanɔ yaɛ ende Mungu.
english: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’ Numbers 30:2

lokele: Nde Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo— Otinyëke ekanɔ angɔmwito, ango la Use, eoka Use wende kɛka ya Mungu;
english: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

lokele: ango la wenda-bo eoka wenda-bo wende esolo ya bakolo bande; ango la Yelusaleme eoka wende bokenge wa Bɔkɔta Ofi.
english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

lokele: Otinyëke ekanɔ la botö waɛ, eoka otikɔkɔlɛ ndokikola loswe lɔmwito lofufu ango windo.
english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

lokele: Lioi liaɛ liyaleke ango ko Eingo, eingo, Mbayɔ, Mbayɔ; lioi lioeta bao lile ko libe kongo. Bosakane
english: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

lokele: Osooka mbo loaongomökö mbo— Liso swana la liso, la linyo swana la linyo;
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’ Exodus 21:24

lokele: nde Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo— Otambëke oto obe bokondo, nde boto eom’aɛ nda likɛkɛ lia olome, tambak’imɔ ko inde elia wali.
english: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

lokele: Boto ɛlɛmbɛ otinjak’aɛ nda likomyi eoka ya esinda yaɛ, fak’imɔ ko inde kanjo.
english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

lokele: Boto ɛkɛs’aɛ lande botikake wa kilometa ɛmɔi, kɛndɛkɛ lande ko imbale.
english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

lokele: Faefak’inde oyatömba yeka yaɛ la olotelëk’inde oyalɛmbi ndɔsɔ yeka sɔmbya end’aɛ. Losamɔ
english: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

lokele: Osooka mbo loaongomökö mbo— Samaka boyalani l’aɛ nde koiyela ewa liya.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor Leviticus 19:18 and hate your enemy.’ 5:43

lokele: Nde Imi nd’atoonga lanu mbo— Samaka eba liya, sombolelak’iyo ebatokongol’ino,
english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

lokele: mbo boyaleke bana ba Sango wanu nda Use, eoka Inde nd’asokomya mbo löwa loande losɔswɛkɛ ende ebalau l’ebabe lisanga, la Inde nd’atotɔnɛsɛ mbula end’eba liengani, l’ebatiengane lisanga.
english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

lokele: ¿Eoka eyambo bosama ko bato ebasosam’ino, ani boni bondanda botɔɔlɔ ino? ¿Bɛsɔnji ya besombi baitokelaka ko ongoma?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

lokele: ¿Eyambo bolamokola ko beoto yanu kongo, boni to olau woeta bato basi? ¿Ebati BaYuda baitokeleka ko ongoma?
english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors 5:47 do the same?

lokele: Ɔlɔlɔkɔ to nde liengani kwani ayali Sango wanu oyale nda Use, Inde nd’asɔɔlwa hɔlɔ.
english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

lokele: Taenyelaka la wɛlï mbo otakelaka eya liengani ko mbo bato bɛnɛkɛ ino mbo wende balau, eoka ko ani ot’imɔ wofomo bondanda ende Sango wanu oyayali nda Use.
english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving 6:1 before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

lokele: Eokao atokusol’aɛ lifaefi liosunga ebatouwe, otëke to boekï oso, kwa atokelaka balimbakeli nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ nda mboka, mbo basemolomoko la bato. Wewe isoonga lanu mbo iyo ana basɔɔlɔ bondanda wau fɛɛ.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

lokele: Nde atokusola aɛ lifaefi, bosamba waɛ wa wali boluwëke elotokela ewa olome,
english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

lokele: mbo lifaefi lia ngandi yaɛ liyaleke wisakumbo, limɔ Sango waɛ oyatɔɛnɛ wisisa ɛɔlɛsɛkɛ aɛ bondanda. Lisomboli lia momongo
english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

lokele: Atosombol’ino, okelëke kwa ebalimbakeli eoka iyo basami wemala nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ la nda bau ba mboka mbo bato bɛnɛk’iyo; wewe isoonga lanu mbo iyo basɔɔlɔ bondanda wau fɛɛ.
english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

lokele: Kongo ko, atosombol’aɛ ɔtokɔ hɔu nda kuku ya ndakɔ yaɛ, limɔ bome boliyama ndi, aɛ kosombola Sango waɛ oyayali nda wisakumbo; la Sango waɛ oyatɔɛnɛ wisisa ɛɔlɛsɛkɛ aɛ bondanda.
english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

lokele: Atosombokol’ino, osombolëke boongaonga kwa atokelaka ebati BaYuda, eoka iyo batangi nde mbo batookomo eoka ya wike wa beongaonga.
english: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

lokele: Okweekelëk’iyo eoka Mungu Sango wanu nd’aluwi yao ebisoeno ino ani okafel’Inde.
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

lokele: Eokao ino sombolaka ko ani mbo— Sango wasu oyayali nda Use, Lina liaɛ lilitesomoko,
english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

lokele: Bɔkɔta waɛ boyeke; Lisangi liaɛ likelomoko, Kwa atokelomo liao nda Use, ko ongoma ono se;
english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

lokele: Faefak’iso louse bieka yoengana louse,
english: Give us today our daily bread.

lokele: Mɛsɛlɛk’iso batongwi basu kwa iso imɔ Tosotamɛsɛlɛ iyo ebatotongwa lasu.
english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

lokele: Okɛsɛk’iso nda lisoshela, Kangä ɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ iso nda obe.
english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’ 6:13

lokele: Eoka eyambo bomɛsɛlɛ bato batongwi bau, Sango wanu imɔ atomɛsɛlɛ ko batongwi banu,
english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

lokele: nde eyambo ino otimɛsɛlɛ bato, ani Sango wanu aitomesɛlɛ ango batongwi banu.
english: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

lokele: Atokilak’ino bieka, oyalëke la biɔmbɔ wuno kwa atokelaka ebalimbakeli, eoka batonunakalesa biɔmbɔ yau, mbo bɛnɔmɔkɔ la bato mbo batile yeka. Wewe isoonga lanu mbo basɔɔlɔ bondanda wau fɛɛ.
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

lokele: Kongo ko atokilak’ino lɔɔkɔ betö yanu la baningo, soolaka biɔmbɔ yanu,
english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

lokele: mbo bato bataɛnɛ likili lianu lia bieka, kangä Sango wanu oyayali nda wisakumbo, limɔ Sango wanu oyasɔɛnɛ wisisa Inde ɛɔlɛsɛkɛ ino bondanda.
english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

lokele: Osɔnjɛ̈kɛ bondanda wanu ono se, olo sambola la batälɛ la mbombö batosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ wao, la olo eba biya batofindola etutu mbo biyeke wao;
english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

lokele: kongo ko sɔnjaka bondanda nda Use, ona angoko sambola, angoko batälɛ la mbombö angosɛɛsɛlɛsɛkɛ wao, angoko eba biya angofindola, ango wiya yeka.
english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

lokele: Eoka olo ayali bondanda waɛ, botema waɛ boyalaka imɔ ko omao.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

lokele: Täla ya bindo ende liso, eokao liso liaɛ liyala fololo, bindo yaɛ bitotina bitoana swaa.
english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

lokele: Nde ango liso liaɛ liyala libe, bindo yaɛ bitotina bitosɔlɔnɔ sɔlɛ̈ la lilima. Eokao eya ngo mbo liangangi elile laɛ litufaka, aina to botufɛlɛ.
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

lokele: Angwɛnɛ oto wokɔkɔlɔ oyala bɔkɔwa wa bato ambale, eoka mbo ataiyana la ɔmɔi nde kosamaka oyo ɔmɔi, angoko atowatema la ɔmɔi nde kosɛɔlɔ oyo ɔmɔi; otikɔkɔlɛ oyala bɔkɔwa wa Mungu la bieto lisanga.
english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

lokele: Eokao, itoonga lanu mbo— Otakelëke bolenda loasɔ loa liwawi lianu mbo toleke to eni yeka, tomweke to iye; ango ko loasɔ loa bindo mbo towateke bini bisinda. ¿Liwawi liisoeta yeka yola? ¿Bindo biisoeta bisinda yowata?
english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

lokele: Tichaka nɔli nda use, biitolɔɔ, biitoina, biitoisaka eula nda ekukyelo, kongo ko Sango wanu wa Use atoles’iyo; ¿Ino oisolongel’iyo finɛ?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

lokele: Ndai wanu kokɔkɔlɔ ndokondesa bindo yande ko sinyo kongo, eoka ndotakela bolenda nda yao?
english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment 6:27 to his lifespan?

lokele: ¿Monito bototakela bisinda yowata bolenda? Taenyelaka fɔtɔtɔ ya lokonda, biitokela likuwa, biitotita bisinda,
english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

lokele: kongo ko itoonga nde lanu mbo— Ango Solomo angɛnɛ kwa aaka inde la bɔfɛkɔ wa likama, atiawataka bɔfɛkɔ woengana la lɔfɔtɔtɔ lɔmwitɔ loa lokonda.
english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

lokele: Eya to mbo Mungu asowatesa ko chwingi chwa lokonda la bofɛkɔ ani, chwingi etosoyala louse nde lɛlɛngɔ tototomo nda etumbelo, nde simbi to Inde kowates’ino bato ba lilendelu likɛkɛ.
english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

lokele: Eokao otakelëke bolenda mbo— ¿Iye eyetolak’iso?, ¿Iye eyetomw’iso? ango ko mbo— ¿Eni yeka eyetowat’iso?
english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

lokele: Yeka bina, ebati BaYuda batokalukake yao, Nde Sango wanu wa Use aluwi mbo botoeno nde ebitotina-bi.
english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

lokele: Talukaka Bɔkɔta wa Mungu la eliande liengani, limɔ ebi-bitotina kofomoko ino imɔ.
english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

lokele: Eokao otakelëke bolenda loasɔ loa lɛlɛngɔ, eoka bocho wa ɛlɛngɔ bototakela bolenda ko eya wao angɛnɛ. Eweuse bokanelu nde la obe wa wao.
english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

lokele: Ofëke bato se lifela, mbo aɛ angɛnɛ otafomo se.
english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

lokele: Eoka ko la liataki elisoatak’aɛ loasɔ; aɛ angɛnɛ koatakomo imɔ la liao; la ikweelo esitokweel’ino la basi, ino bokweelomoko imɔ la shao.
english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

lokele: Monito ototichaka lofututi elole nda liso lia wina nde angolembeela bokangela ebole nda liso liaɛ angɛnɛ?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

lokele: ¿Monito otoonga la wina laɛ mbo— Machaka’mi isokoleke lofututi nda liso liaɛ, ani aɛ angɛnɛ ole oko la bokangela nda liso liaɛ angɛnɛ?
english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

lokele: Aɛ bolimbakeli, taɔmɔlɔkɔ bokangela nda liso liaɛ; lamao aɛ kokɔkɔlɔ ɔɛnɛ sandelele ndɔɔmɔlɔ lofututi nda liso lia wina.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

lokele: Ofaefëke ebitanu ende ngwa, ɔwɛlɛ̈kɛ bieto ya loketi oso wa ndei, Mbo ndei bitamatekela yao la batindi la mbo ngwa bitakikwel’ino mbo bitaichak’ino bainyo. Lisomboli
english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

lokele: Felaka, limɔ bitofomo ino; lukaka limɔ ino koosha eyetoluk’ino; titaka limɔ bome kolioelomo ino.
english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

lokele: Eoka boto la boto oyatofela, inde kɔɔlɔ; oyatoluka, inde koosha; end’inde oyatotita, wao koliolomo.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

lokele: ¿Oni boto wanu oyasofelomo lituma ko la wana wande, atof’inde litalɛ?
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

lokele: ¿Ango ko eomba swi, sango kof’inde njɔ?
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

lokele: Eokao, eyambo ino, bato abe oluwi ndofaefa bana banu bafi balau, nde simbi to Sango wanu oyayali nda Use, efaka yeka ilau ende ebasofel’Inde.
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

lokele: Eokao ebisolɛmb’ino mbo bato bakeelek’ino, keelak’imɔ ko iyo ongoma, eoka Bikela la Baoi ba Batɔndɔli bengani nde ko la lioi-li.
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

lokele: Ɔtɔkɔ hɔu nda bome ewamwanu, eoka bome bofalu la mboka efolali bitɔkɛ ko nda lɔsɛɛsɛlɔ, bende to wike ebatɔɔtɔkɔ nda wao.
english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

lokele: Kongo ko shomome shende siwamwanu la imbomboka shende la bokamu esitɔkɛ ko nda liwawi, la bato bende bamyɔ ebatoosha shao.
english: How 7:14 narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

lokele: Taenyelaka la wɛlï eoka ya batɔndɔli ebati la momongo ebatoya end’ino la wɛnɛlɔ wa bɛkɔkɔ nde wewe bende atiteni kwa ngɔi ya luno.
english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

lokele: Botolembeel’iyo ko la tuma twau. ¿Bato kotwa toyayöliki nda toyangiakau? ¿Kolukä sau nda toilaila?
english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

lokele: Ko ongoma, isandu silau sitota tuma tolau; nde isandu esisɔɔlɔ angota tuma tolau.
english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

lokele: Isandu silau siitokɔkɔlɔ ota tuma tobe la isandu esisɔɔlɔ angokɔkɔlɔ ota tuma tolau.
english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

lokele: Isandu l’isandu esiitota tuma tolau, shao sitotindomo kokumbolomo nda bösä.
english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

lokele: Eokao botolembeel’iyo ko la tuma twau.
english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

lokele: Bati to ebatotina ebatotangaka’mi mbo Ngɛnɛ, Ngɛnɛ ebatɔɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Use, mbayɔ; kangä ebatokelaka lisangi lia Sango wami oyayali nda Use.
english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

lokele: Nda lise lina lia liili, wike belaongaka lami mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, Ngɛnɛ, totiatɔndɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ nda lina liaɛ; totiakusoläkä belimo ibe nda lina liaɛ, totiakeläkä tokesa nda lina liaɛ?
english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

lokele: Limɔ Imi koonga lau mbo— Itialuwäkä ino ango sinyo, sokwaka ende’mi, ino eba Iotefola. Besweli Imbale ya Ndakɔ
english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

lokele: Eokao oyatooka baoi-ba bami, inde kokɔcha bao, atokweelomo la boto wa wɛlï wotaenyela loasɔ loa liswi lia ndakɔ yande nda batälɛ,
english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

lokele: limɔ mbula lɔtɔnɔ tɔitɔi, betima losecha sondwäsondwä, lofofo lofofa fofoo, yao loomanakela ndakɔ ena, kongo ko ndakɔ angoukwa eoka yao loswama se suu nda batälɛ.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

lokele: Boto oyatooka baoi-ba bami, nde atikɔchɛ bao, inde kokweelomo la boto w’ebebe oyaswäkä ndakɔ yande nda nyɛlɛ yoke,
english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

lokele: limɔ mbula lɔtɔnɔ tɔitɔi, betima losecha sondwäsondwä, lofofo lofofa fofoo, yao loomanakela ndakɔ ena la yao loukwa kwuu, liukwi lifi fafo.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

lokele: Asiläkä Yesu ndoonga baoi-ba biindi ya bato lomwaala liekesi liande, eoka Inde loekekes’iyo la isosha inga kwa aekesäkä batikasa bau.
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

lokele: Ayäkä Yesu se ndoyasokwa nda löngo, bikuku bifi ya bato lotut’Inde.
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

lokele: Futuku, boto wa baɛndi loya ende Inde, inde lokwa bakulusembe oso wande’inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, bolɛmbɛ, aɛ kokɔkɔlɔ ndotanesa’mi.
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

lokele: Yesu lonanola bosamba, Inde lomat’inde, Inde mbo— Ilɛmbi nde ongoma, tanesomoko to. Lisasaya baɛndi lotanesomo.
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Tɛnɛkɛ, okambesëke oto angɔmwitoto, nde kɛndɛkɛ okatamba bindo yaɛ ende kanga, faefaka Mungu lifaefi kwa ataka Mose ekela kwa ndembe ende bato. Liuwesomu lia Bɔkɔwa wa Komanda
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

lokele: Aɔtɔkɔ Inde nda Kafenauma, Komanda wa basilikani loya oyalɔmbɔkɔl’Inde,
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

lokele: inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, bɔkɔwa wami aingali se nda ndakɔ la loo loa bɔlɛmbɛtɛ la bomusi finɛ.
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Itoya ndoyasäsola inde.
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

lokele: Komanda lomutola mbo— Ngɛnɛ, itiengane mbo ɔɔtɛkɛ ose ya bɔtɔndɔ wami, nde waonga ngo ko lioi kongo, limɔ bɔkɔwa wami kosäsolomo;
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

lokele: eoka imi angɛnɛ yende oto wolitesa isosha la yende imɔ la basilikani ose yami, la yeonga la ɔmɔi mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ, limɔ atɔkɛ; la ende wasi mbo— Yauku, inde atoya; la ende bɔkɔwa wami mbo— Kelaka lona, limɔ atokela loao.
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

lokele: Okaka Yesu baoi-ba, Inde lomwaala, Inde loonga lau ebatutaka mbo— Ikoshi kɔni liimeli lifi ongoma ango ende bato ba Isalaele angɛnɛ.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

lokele: Isoonga lanu ongoma wewe la mbo wike besokwaka fangi ya batɛmwɛlɔ ba bonyanya la fangi ya litele ndoyayalaka se nda bieka amamwito la Abalayama la Yisaka la Yakobo nda Bɔkɔta wa Use,
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

lokele: nde bana ba Bɔkɔta belaumbolomoko nda lilima lousa, olo elayalaka bileli la ngɛlɛtɛ ya bainyo.
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga la Komanda mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ to; kwani asoimel’aɛ, loao lokelomoko ko ongoma end’aɛ, la bɔkɔwa wande losäsolomo ko la mbile-ao.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

lokele: Ɔtɔkɔ Yesu nda ndakɔ ya Petelo, Inde loosha boïli wa Petelo nda efima la loo loa etao.
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

lokele: Yesu lomata bosamba wande limɔ etao losokwa end’otomali, inde loemala ndokasung’inde.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him. 8:15

lokele: La likɔlɔse, iyo loesel’Inde bato wike ebaaka la belimo ebe lamao Inde lokusola belimo ko la lioi, la Inde losäsola batotina eba kambo,
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

lokele: mbo lioi eliaongomökö la Yesaya Bɔtɔndɔli likɔchɔmɔkɔ mbo— Inde angɛnɛ aɔlɔkɔ bɛlɛmbu yasu, Atolaka imɔ ngwo yasu.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.” Isaiah 53:4

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ Yesu biindi bifi bisolingel’Inde, Inde loonga lau mbo balekeke nda boili wasi,
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

lokele: nde Botikasa ɔmɔi loyaonga lande mbo— Boekesi itutek’Aɛ l’olo atɔkɛ laɛ.
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Bɛlɛndɛ bile la baondo la nɔli bile la bikalingo, nde Wana wa Boto ati ango la elela yoingesa botö wande se.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

lokele: Boeki wasi loonga lande mbo— Tamachaka’mi mbo ikɛkɛ okaomba sango wami.
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lande mbo— Tutaka’mi, la machaka ebasowa baombakeke ebawi lau. Yesu lɔɔngɛsɛ lomba nda Eliya
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

lokele: Akwaka Yesu nda watɔ, baeki bande lotut’Inde,
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

lokele: Futuku lomba lofi loya se nda eliya la ongoma watɔ bosiki olia la batutu, nde Yesu loingalaka ilɔ;
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

lokele: Baeki loyasisɔl’Inde, iyo mbo— Ngɛnɛ, uwes’iso, tososɛɛsɛlɛ.
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Owängiki moni? Ino ba boeno wa lilendelu. Lamao Inde loemala, Inde loima lofofo la balia, la eliya lotemba tembelele.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

lokele: Nde bato lomwaala, iyo mbo— Boni bɔfɔnɔ wa boto-yo, eoka la lomba la balia ba eliya kolitesa lioi liande. Boto wa Bolimo Bobe
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

lokele: Iyaka Yesu nda boili wasi, boko yese ya BaKelesene, bato bambale ebayalaka la belimo ebe loyatowana lande. Bakuswaka nda fowa biko sai oyatowana lande, la eoka ya bolengi finɛ angwɛnɛ boto wokɔkɔlɔ ndoeta la mboka ena.
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, 8:28 two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

lokele: Futuku iyo loamama mbo— Iso laɛ twende la loni loasɔ, Aɛ Wana wa Mungu? Oyi nde eyamaya ndoyokes’iso biäle oso wa lisho liasu?
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

lokele: Esika lau liasa lia ndɛi yaläkä bieka.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

lokele: Belimo ebe losombol’Inde mbo— Bokusol’iso, kɛsɛkɛ to iso nda liasa lia ndɛi. Inde loonga lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ.
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

lokele: Akuswäkä iyo, iyo lɔɔtɛlɛ ndɛi limɔ liasa litotina lokwa mangu konda löngo konda eliya la yao lowa nda balia.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

lokele: Betingani ya ndɛi lofata mangu konda bokenge, iyo lokambesa bato bitotina loasɔ loa bato ana ebayalaka la belimo ebe.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

lokele: Lisasaya batotina ba bokenge lokuswakuswaka oyatowana la Yesu; ɛnɛk’iyo wɛnɛ Inde, iyo losombola Inde mbo asekweke nda yese yau.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

lokele: Limɔ Inde lokwa nda watɔ, Inde loleka, Inde loiya nda okenge wande angɛnɛ. Boto wa Lonyango
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

lokele: Omao iyo loeshel’Inde boto wa lonyango, aingalaka tambelele nda tange; ɛnɛkɛ Yesu liimeli liau Inde loonga la ewa lonyango mbo— Wana, sambolaka botema, njasɔ ibe yaɛ bisomɛsɛlɔmɔ.
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

lokele: Lamao batikasa bamɔi loonganaka mbo— Boto-yo asosɛɔlɔ Mungu.
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

lokele: Aluwäkä Yesu baenyeli ba betema yau, Inde mbo— ¿Monito otoenyela obe nda betema yanu?
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

lokele: Loni losoeta la ɔlɛmbu, kwa ndoonga mbo— Njasɔ ibe yaɛ bisomɛsɔlɔmɔ, kwa ndoonga mbo— Emalaka la tangwaka?
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

lokele: Kongo ko mbo boluweke mbo Wana wa Boto ende la isosha shomɛsɛlɛ njasɔ ibe ono se, limɔ Inde loonga la ewa lonyango mbo— Emalaka, ilaka tange yaɛ, la kɛndɛkɛ nda ndakɔ yaɛ.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

lokele: Boto loemala yai, inde lɔkakɛ nda ndakɔ yande.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ windi wa bato ongoma, iyo lowanga, iyo loinela Mungu oyasofa bato isosha sha bɔfɔnɔ-bo. Lotomo-lioi loa Lewi
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

lokele: Etaka Yesu omao Inde lɔɛnɛ boto ako Matayo, ani ayaläkä se nda ɛsɔnjɛlɔ ya bɔsɔmbi, la Inde loonga lande mbo— Tutaka’mi. Inde loemala la inde lotuta Yesu.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

lokele: Lamao ayalaka Yesu nda mɛsa nda ndakɔ, bɛsɔnji ya bɛsɔmbi la bato ba njasɔ ibe wike loya oyayalaka la Yesu la baeki bande.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ BaFalusi ongoma, iyo loonga la baeki bande mbo— ¿Monito Boekesi wanu atola bieka amamwito la bɛsɔnji la bato abe?
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

lokele: Okäkä Yesu ongoma, Inde loonga lau mbo— Ebale la bosasu baitolüka bonganga kangä eba kambo.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

lokele: Kɛndɛkɛ okeka litina lia elioi-li liko mbo— Ilɛmbi nde booto, inga nyama yoolomu; eoka itiye oyata eba liengani lioi, kangä eba njasɔ ibe.
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ Hosea 6:6 for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.” 9:13

lokele: Lamao baeki ba Yoane loya ende Inde, iyo mbo— ¿Monito la iso la BaFalusi, totokilaka ndola bieka mbile la mbile, kongo ko baeki baɛ baitokila?
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Atoyalaka tolesani amamwito la oyatosɔngɔ, batokɔkɔlɔ ndolelaka? Bacho beyaka nde ani bɔsɔngi atɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ end’iyo, limɔ iyo kokila bieka.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

lokele: Boto aitowamba esinda ya liɔmbɔ la yaki ya esinda eyai, eoka mbamba ya esinda eyai etosalaka eya liɔmbɔ limɔ lifola litofalwa.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

lokele: Boto aitoangola banä bayai nda biuku ebisoumwa eoka mbo banä bataacha biuku, limɔ banä batowɛlɛmɛkɛ se la biuku kowa; nde banä bayai batowɛlɔmɔ nda biuku biyai, l’ani yao imbale kotekama. Wana Otomali wa Yailo
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

lokele: Aongäkä Yesu baoi-ba, bokumi ɔmɔi loya oyakwa balui se oso wande, inde mbo— Wana otomali wami asokwela se ko kwani, kongo ko yauku oyatalia inde bosamba waɛ, limɔ ewawaka.
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

lokele: Yesu loemala, Inde lotut’inde la baeki bande lisanga.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

lokele: Limɔ botomali oyayalaka la lisendwi lia bakila ko miaka liu la imbale; inde loya ombisa ya Yesu, inde lomata lisɛmbɛlɛ lia esinda ya Yesu,
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe 9:20 of his garment;

lokele: eoka inde loonga nda botema wande mbo— Yemata ango esinda yande imi kouwesomo.
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu lokikwa, Inde lɔɛnɛ otomali, Inde mbo— Wana otomali, sambolaka botema, liimeli liaɛ lisouwes’aɛ. Ko la mbile-ao otomali ona louwesomo.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

lokele: Iyäkä Yesu nda ndakɔ ya bokumi, Inde lɔɛnɛ ebatoomaka tofonge la limbilititi lia bato batofichaka etondo efi,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Sokwaka eya, boseka atiwe, aingali ilɔ! limɔ iyo losɛkɛlɛ Inde finɛ.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

lokele: Nde asokolomökö windi wa bato, Inde lɔɔtɔ ndakɔ, Inde lounda boseka la lingasa, inde loemala yai.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

lokele: Lokuku loa eloasɔ-lo lofafana nda yese ena etotina. Bato bambale ba botuku
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

lokele: Etaka Yesu omao bato bambale ba botuku lotutak’Inde, iyo loamama mbo— Welak’iso shota, Aɛ Wana wa Dawidi.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

lokele: Ɔtɔkɔ Inde nda ndakɔ, iyo loya end’Inde; limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Oimeli nde mbo isokɔkɔlɔ okeel’ino eloasɔ-lo? Iyo mbo— Eingo Ngɛnɛ.
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lomata baiso bau, Inde mbo— Lokeelomoko ino kwa ayali imɔ ko liimeli lianu.
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

lokele: Limɔ baiso bau loliolomo. Yesu loimak’iyo mbo— Otaluwesëke boto angɔmɔi.
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

lokele: Nde iyo losokwa omao, limɔ iyo lofafanesa lokuku loande nda yese ena etotina.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

lokele: Atangwäkä ebato-ba, tɛnɛ boto weuma oyaɔtɛlɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ imɔ la bolimo obe!
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

lokele: Asokolomökö bolimo obe eweuma loongaka, la windi wa bato lomwaala, iyo mbo— Lotitɛnɛlɛkɛ kɔni ongoma nda Isalaele.
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

lokele: Kongo ko BaFalusi loakola ndoonga mbo— Ende ko la bɔkɔta wa belimo ebe eyetokusol’Inde belimo ebe. Kɛndɔ ya Yesu yonangola Mboli Ilau
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

lokele: Yesu lɔkɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ nda kenge bifi la ebikɛkɛ bitotina bitimbi ndokaekese nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ yau, Inde lonangokolaka Mboli Ilau ya Bɔkɔta la Inde louwekekesa bato ba ngwo la kambo ya bɛfɔnɔ bitotina.
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛk’Inde biindi ya bato Inde lookel’iyo ngandi, eoka baeyaeyäkä, batekukumäkä kwa bɛkɔkɔ ebiti la botingani.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed 9:36 and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo— Eula yende efi nde ebatotwaka yao bende bamyɔ,
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

lokele: eokao sombokolaka Ngɛnɛ wa eula mbo atomeke batwi nda eula yande.
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu lota baeki bande liu la ambale lioi limɔ Inde lofaef’iyo isosha shokusola belimo ebe la shosäsekesa ngwo la kambo ya bɛfɔnɔ bitotina.
english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

lokele: Baina ba batomomu liu la ambale bako mbo— ewa oso ako Petelo, la Andelo etungani yande; Yakobo wana wa Sebedayo la Yoane etungani yande;
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

lokele: Filipo la Balatomayo, Toma la Matayo, ewa bɔsɔnji wa bɔsɔmbi; Yakobo wana wa Alufayo, la Tadayo;
english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called 10:3 Thaddaeus;

lokele: Simona wa Kanana, la Yudasi wa Keliota oyawambäkä Yesu.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

lokele: Yesu lotoma eba liu la ambale, Inde loima iyo mbo— Ɔkɛndɛ̈kɛ nda mboka ya ebati BaYuda, ɔɔtɛkɛ nda okenge wa eba Samalia,
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

lokele: kangä kɔkɛ ende bɛkɔkɔ ebelefani ya tukela ya Isalaele.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

lokele: Atɔkɛndɛkɛnd’ino, taka boekï mbo— Bɔkɔta wa Use bosoya tina.
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

lokele: Säsekesaka eba ngwo, uwesaka ebasowa, tanekesaka eba baɛndi, kusolaka belimo ebe; Osɔɔlɔ liɔlɛlɛ, faka to lifaefela.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, 10:8 and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

lokele: Ɔɛ̈kɛ la falanga ango ko bakuta nda biuku yanu, ɔɛ̈kɛ la litanga, ango ko bisinda imbale,
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

lokele: ango ko bilato, ango ko itumbe eoka bosali aondu nde ofomo pɔshɔ yande.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

lokele: La nda okenge ona, kwa ofi kwa bɔkɛkɛ ebokaɔtɛk’ino, lukäka boto oyaengani la yalaka komao lande, kond’akasekwek’ino omao.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

lokele: Akaɔtɛk’ino ndakɔ, seelaka yao,
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

lokele: eya mbo ndakɔ engani, ambo lilatemi lianu liyaleke la yao, nde eyambo etiengane, ambo lilatemi lianu liinweke end’ino.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

lokele: Eyambo boto aitonyangel’ino la aitooka baoi banu, akosokwek’ino nda ndakɔ ena, kwa nda bokenge ona, fufolaka liunge elisowatema la batindi banu.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

lokele: Wewe, isoonga lanu mbo— Yese ya Sodoma la Ngomola angooka likuchi lifi elikokeke bokenge ona nda lise lia likomyi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, Imi isotom’ino kwa bɛkɔkɔ nd’atiteni ya ngɔi, eokao yalaka la wɛlï kwa ewa njɔ, la yalaka la esaela kwa eya biküku.
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

lokele: Lambaka to mbo bato batakɛsɛk’ino ende tokumbɛ, eoka batoomak’ino fimbo nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ;
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

lokele: bemesak’ino oso wa bekumi la bekɔta eoka yami mbo oongeleke’mi oso wau la oso wa ebati BaYuda.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

lokele: Kongo ko atoundes’iyo ounda ino, ndokakɛsɔmɔ ende bekumi otakelëke olenda eoka ya boongeli ango eoka ya baoi angɛnɛ ebakaongek’ino eoka baoi boonga befomoko end’ino nda mbile-ao.
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

lokele: Eoka bati nde ino angɛnɛ nd’atoonga, kangä Bolimo wa Sango wanu oyatoonga ko lanu.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

lokele: Boloo atowamba etungani nda liwa, la sango atowamba wana, la bana batotefola ebaot’iyo mbo bakɛsɛk’iyo nda liwa,
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

lokele: la ino boiyanomoko la bato batotina eoka ya lina liami. Nde inde oyatokɔkɔmɔ konda losilo, inde elauwesomoko.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

lokele: Nde atokongola bato ekongol’ino nda bokenge-bo, kwaka otili konda bokenge wasi, eoka isoonga lanu wewe mbo ino angotasila otandela bekenge bitotina ya Isalaele oso wa loyo loa Wana wa Boto.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

lokele: Boeki aitolongela Boekesi wande la bɔkɔwa aitolongela Ngɛnɛ wande;
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

lokele: loengani nde mbo boeki ayaleke kwa Boekesi wande la bɔkɔwa kwa Ngɛnɛ wande. Betanga ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ mbo Baalasebula, nde asa kɔni iyo kɔsɛɔlɔ eba bofindi wande.
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, 10:25 how much more those of his household!

lokele: Eokao owangëk’iyo, eoka angwɛnɛ eyaisama sakolo ko ndoisolomo; angwɛnɛ loasɔ eloisomuku sakolo ko ndolüwakomo mbisa.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

lokele: Ebitokambesa’mi okambes’ino nda lilima, ongaka to yao nda löwa; ebitook’ino la iyoiyoi, taka boekï wa yao nda bɛtɔndɔ ya ndakɔ.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

lokele: Owangëke ebatoola bindo nde batikɔkɔlɛ ndoola bolimo; kongo ko wangaka inde oyasokɔkɔlɔ ndosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ la bolimo la bindo nda Ngehena.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna. 10:28

lokele: ¿Mbo bɛnjwɛɛ imbale biitoungesomo la likute? Nde ɔmɔi wa yao angokwa se nda nyɛlɛ sakolo ko la Sango wanu.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? 10:29 Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

lokele: Nde eyanu swee ya betö bitotina bisolüwana loketi.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

lokele: Eokao, owangëke, eoka ino nd’asolongela bɛnjwɛɛ la loketi lofi.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

lokele: Eokao boto eaolela Imi oso wa bato, Imi yaolelak’inde oso wa Sango wami oyayali nda Use;
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

lokele: nde boto eanganya Imi oso wa bato, Imi yelaanganyaka imɔ ko wao oso wa Sango wami nda Use.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

lokele: Oenyelëke mbo isoya oyasɛlɛ lilatemi ono se, itiye oyasɛlɛ ko lilatemi kangä chaka ya bita.
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

lokele: Isoya nde ndowesanesa botö la sango wande, la wana otomali la nyango wande la wali wa wana la boilana lande,
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

lokele: ani baiyani ba boto ko bato ba bukulu wande angɛnɛ.
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household. Micah 7:6

lokele: Boto oyasami sango kwa nyango ndolongela Imi, ona angoöndo otangomo wami, la oyatosama wanaotolome kwa wana-otomali ndolongela Imi, wao imɔ angoöndo otangomo wami;
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

lokele: la oto ona oyaitoilaka lieka liande ndotuta’mi, ambo wao angoöndo oyala boeki wami.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

lokele: Inde oyatolukä ndokukya liwawi liande angɛnɛ, ambo atolefesa nde liao; nde oyatolefesa liwawi liande ko eoka yami, wao koosha nde liao.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

lokele: Inde oyatonyangela ino ambo atonyangela’mi, la inde oyatonyangela’mi, ambo atonyangela oyatomaka’mi.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

lokele: Oyatonyangela bɔtɔndɔli ko eoka mbo ayali bɔtɔndɔli, ɛɔlɔkɔ imɔ bondanda wa bɔtɔndɔli, la boto oyatonyangela boto wa liengani ko eoka mbo ayali ewa liengani ambo ɛɔlɔkɔ imɔ bondanda wa boto wa liengani.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

lokele: Boto oyatomwesa ɔmwito wa ebakɛkɛ-ba kɔpɔ ya balia ba bondiya ko eoka mbo ayali boeki, itoonga lanu wewe mbo aitoomelo bondanda wande.
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

lokele: Asilaka Yesu ndoekesa baeki bande liu la bambale, Inde losekwa nda elel’ao okanangola la okekesa nda bekenge yau. Wɛndi wa Yoane Bolufï nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

lokele: Okakä Yoane olo nda ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, bekeeli eyakeläkä Masiya, inde lotoma wɛndi la baeki bande, okafel’Inde mbo—
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

lokele: ¿Aɛ nd’ale Inde oyakayeke, kwa mbo tolukeke wasi?
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ la kambesaka Yoane ebisoɛnɛ ino la ebisook’ino,
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

lokele: mbo eba betuku batɔɔlɔ liɛni, eba bikoti basokɛndɛ fii, eba baɛndi basotanesomo, eba biokö basooka, ebawi basoemesomo, la eba touwe basonangoelomo Mboli Ilau;
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, Isaiah 35:5 the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them. Isaiah 61:1-4

lokele: limɛngɔ lile la oto ona oyaitoɛnɛ tale eoka yami.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

lokele: Atangwäkä eba wɛndi, Yesu loakola ndoonga la bikuke ya bato loasɔ loa Yoane, Inde mbo— ¿Ino waɛkɛ nda liɔmbɛlɛ okɛnɛ iye? ¿Mbo liangala elisolɛlɛlɛlɛ la lofofo?
english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

lokele: ¿Waɛkɛ nde okɛnɛ iye to? ¿Mbo oto oyawati bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ? Tɛnɛ ngo, ebatowata bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ bayali nda ndakɔ ya bɛkɔta.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

lokele: ¿Nde ino waɛkɛ eoka iye to? ¿Okɛnɛ bɔtɔndɔli? Eingo ko, isoonga lanu mbo asolongela bɔtɔndɔli.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

lokele: End’inde oyatelomoko nda lokasa mbo— Tɛnɛ, itotoma wɛndi wami oso waɛ, Oyatokakomya mboka yaɛ oso waɛ.
