english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’ Malachi 3:1

lokele: Wewe, isoonga lanu mbo angwɛnɛ boto oyasootomo la otomali asoɛnɛlɛ wolongela Yoane Bolufi, kongo ko inde oyayali ewa liili nda Bɔkɔta wa Use asolongela nde Yoane.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

lokele: Konda bacho ba Yoane Bolufi konda kwani Bɔkɔta wa Use bosɔɔtɔmɔ ko la botatulu l’eba botatulu batundesa wao tafi.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force. 11:12

lokele: Eoka Batɔndɔli batotina la Bikela yatɔndɔlɔmɔkɔ ko ende Yoane,
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

lokele: la eyambo bɔlɛmbɛ ndoimela ongoma ambo ende Eliya oyakayeke.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

lokele: Oyale la batoi, okeke.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

lokele: ¿Itokweela to nde efɛtɔ-ye l’iye? Yende kwa bana ebasoyalaka se nda liongo, batotakana la baina lau lioi mbo—
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

lokele: Tosoomel’ino bofilingi, nde otiineke bisha, tosoleel’ino etondo, nde otiomakeke yɛlɔ nda ewa.
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

lokele: Nde Yoane asoya, angola la angomwa, limɔ basoonga mbo ale la bolimo obe;
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

lokele: Wana wa boto asoya, ani atola la atomwa limɔ basoonga mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, ende afofa la bowi bänä, lisaɔ lia basɔnji ba bɛsɔmbi la bato abe. Nde Wɛlï bosoluwana olau ko la bekeeli ya wao. Lofomo se loa bekenge ya Ngalilai
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.” 11:19

lokele: Lamao Yesu loakola ndofaka bekenge liɛngɔ olo akelomökö wike wa bisisho yande, eoka batiakalanganakä, Inde mbo—
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

lokele: Aeko Kolasini, aeko Betesaida; eya to mbo bisisho eyakelomökö eyanu, kokelomo nda Tulo la Sidona, ani bakalanganäkä ko kwalakwala la bakonia nda bindo la bala nda lokomba.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

lokele: Imi mbo— Simbi to elianu likuchi litoeta elia Tulo la Sidona nda lise lia likomyi.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

lokele: ¿L’aɛ moni Kafenauma? ¿Mbo aɛ kotaliomo konda use? Mba, otoumbolomo nda liöndo lia liwa; eoka eya mbo bisisho ebisokelomo eyaɛ, yakelomökö nda Sodomo, ani wao koyalaka kond’eweuse.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. 11:23 For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

lokele: Nde Imi nd’asoonga lanu mbo— Yese ya Sodoma angooka likuchi lifi elikokeke ino nda lise lia likomyi.
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

lokele: Nda mbile-ao Yesu loonga mbo— Sango, isoaola la kelekëlë end’Aɛ ako Ngɛnɛ wa Use la se, eoka mbo osoisa enjasɔ-bi ende eba wɛlï la eba liluwani, nde osoisola yao ende bana’oli.
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

lokele: Eingo ko Sango, eoka loao lɔɛnɛlɛ nde lolau nda lisangi liaɛ.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

lokele: Bitotina bisofomo’mi ko la Sango wami; angwɛnɛ ango ɔmwito oyatolüwa Wana sakolo ngo ko Sango la angwɛnɛ oyatolüwa Sango sakolo ngo ko Wana, la inde imɔ oyatosanga Wana ndɔɛnɛsɛ inde.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

lokele: Yauku to ende’mi ino batotina ebasolewa la bonui la ebasolɛkwa la belito, la Imi nd’atof’ino lwɛumɔ.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

lokele: Tolaka njɛmbɛ yami, yekesek’ino; yende la bɔfɔu la lilatemi nda botema, la otɔɔlɛlɛ belimo yanu lwɛumɔ.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

lokele: Eoka njɛmbɛ yami yende la bɔfɔu la bokuku wami wende la bɔfɛfu.
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

lokele: Nda mbile ena la lise lia Yenga, Yesu loeta nda bilanga ya bangwindi la baeki bande looka isiyɛ, iyo loakola ndotwaka bangwindi la ndolaka bao.
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ BaFalusi ongoma, iyo loonga lande mbo— Tɛnɛngo, baeki baɛ basotefola liti lia Yenga.
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

lokele: Inde lomutola lau mbo— ¿Otitange eloakeläkä Dawidi, inde la ebaaka lande, la lise eliayalak’iyo la isiyɛ?
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

lokele: Mbo inde lɔɔtɛlɛ ndakɔ ya Mungu, inde lola batuma ebatambomökö nda mɛsa ya Mungu ebatiaka bolomo lande la bato bande, sakolo ko la kanga angɛnɛ?
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests? 1 Samuel 21:3-6

lokele: ¿Otitange imɔ nda Lokasa loa Bikela mbo— Nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu la lise lia Yenga, Kanga nd’atotefokola liti lia Yenga nde iyo basosakoelomo.
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

lokele: Itoonga lanu, Imi mbo— Inde oyatolongela Ndakɔ ya Mungu ale ono.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

lokele: Eya ngo mbo walüwa litina lia elioi-li mbo— Ilɛmbi nde booto, inga nyama yolomu, ani otifek’iyo se ebati la litwanelo.
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ Hosea 6:6 you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

lokele: Wana-wa-Boto ende to Ngɛnɛ wa Yenga. Boto wa bosamba bɔlɛmbɛtɛ
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

lokele: Asekwäkä Inde omao, Inde lɔɔtɔ nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ yau,
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

lokele: la boto wa bosamba bɔlɛmbɛtɛ lɔɛnɛlɛ omao. Iyo lofela Yesu mbo— ¿Engani nde la Bikela ndouwesa boto la lise lia Yenga? mbo bawanjeleke Inde.
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

lokele: Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— ¿Ndai wanu oyayali la bɔkɔkɔ ko ɔmwito, la wao bokwa nda liöndo la lise lia Yenga, mbo inde angosaola wao?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

lokele: ¿Boto aisolongela bɔkɔkɔ la loketi lofi? Eokao to engani nde ndokela olau la lise lia Yenga.
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga la boto mbo— Nanolaka bosamba waɛ; inde lonanola wao la wao losäsa kwa ebɔmɔi.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

lokele: Limɔ BaFalusi lokuswa, iyo lɔɔtɔ ikumbɛ loasɔ loande mbo bɛnɛkɛ mboka yool’Inde.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

lokele: Aluwäkä Yesu ongoma Inde losekwa omao okakɛ elela yasi la bikuke ya bato lotut’Inde la Inde louwekes’iyo batotina.
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

lokele: Nde Inde loim’iyo mbo bataluwes’ato loasɔ loande,
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

lokele: mbo baoi ba Yesaya ewa Bɔtɔndɔli bakɔchɔmɔkɔ mbo—
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

lokele: Tɛnɛ, bokuwi wami oyasoaomo lami, Ale bosamomu wami oyasoomalesa botema wami. Itotel’Inde bolimo wami limɔ Inde atoɛnɛsɛ eba biese bitotina Likomyi lia njasɔ.
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

lokele: Aitowalana, aitoanjanjaka, Limiki liande liitookana la oto angɔmwito nda mboka;
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

lokele: Aitotena liökökö elisomatakelomo, aitotiamesa lotambi elokoseka bolïlya; Konda akalongesek’Inde njasɔ ya Liengani limɔ
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

lokele: Ko la lina liande tukela bitotina batokɛsɛkɛlɛ toɛli.
english: In his name, the nations will hope.” Isaiah 42:1-4

lokele: Lamao baeshaka end’Inde boto wa bolimo obe, aaka la botuku la euma la Yesu louwes’inde limɔ ewa euma loonga la inde lɔɛnɛ.
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

lokele: Bikuke ya bato lomwaala, iyo mbo— ¿Oyo ende to Wana wa Dawidi?
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

lokele: Nde okäkä BaFalusi loasɔ-lo iyo mbo— E-botoyo atokusola belimo ebe ko la Balasebula ako bɔkɔta wa belimo ebe.
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

lokele: Yesu aluwäkä baenyeli bau, Inde mbo— Bato ba yese ɛmɔi ebatonana iyo angɛnɛ, yese ena kosɛɛsɛlɛ; ongoma bato ba okenge ɔmɔi kwa bokulu bɔmɔi boatakana onana limɔ wao angokɔkɔmɔ. ¿Satana ekusola Satana, ani asoatana ndonana lande angɛnɛ, ongoma bɔkɔta wande kokɔkɔmɔ monito?
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

lokele: ¿Eya mbo Imi nd’atokusola belimo ebe ko la bofoka wa Balasebula, bana banu nd’atokusola yao ko la ndai?
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

lokele: Eokao, iyo batoyala nde bakomyi banu.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

lokele: Nde eya mbo Imi nd’asokusola belimo ko la Bolimo wa Mungu, aambo Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosoya end’ino.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

lokele: ¿Boto atokɔkɔlɔ ɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya bowangɔ mbo aindeke yeka yande, sakolo ko atotakandaka bowango; lamao inde koindaka ndakɔ yande?
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

lokele: Oyatikɛndɛnɛ lami, inde ende wiyani lami; oyatisɔnjɛ lami, inde nd’atomelesa.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

lokele: Ko l’eokao, isoonga lanu mbo— Njasɔ ibe bitotina la basɛɔli batotina ba bato komɛsɔlɔmɔ kongo ko lisɛɔli lia Bolimo litiangomɛsɛlɔmɔ;
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

lokele: ona boto oyatosɛɔlɔ Wana-wa-Boto, inde komɛsɔlɔmɔ, kongo ko oyatosɛɔlɔ Bolimo Botanu, atilamɛsɛlɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ ango nda mbile-ye ango nda mbile eyekayeke.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

lokele: Takuliaka lɔmɔi—kwa mbo isandu shende silau la tuma twa shao tole tolau; kwa mbo isandu shende sibe la tuma tole tobe lisanga, eoka isandu silembeelomu la tuma twa shao.
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

lokele: Ino lioti lia njɔ, ¿Otokɔkɔlɔ nde ndoonga lioi lilau moni, ani ino angɛnɛ wende abe? Eoka bɔnɔkɔ nd’atoongaka ko yao ebitotumesaka botema.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

lokele: Boto olau atokusolaka ko bilau ebile nda bondanda olau ebotumesi nde botema wande; boto obe atokusokola ko ebibe nda bondanda obe wa botema wande.
english: The good man out of his good treasure 12:35 brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

lokele: Im’itoonga lanu mbo— Nda lise lia Likomyi, bato batofomo nyongo ya lioi la lioi elisoong’iyo liongëlä;
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

lokele: eoka ko la baoi baɛ, aɛ kolongesomoko, la ko la baoi baɛ imɔ, aɛ kofomoko se.
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

lokele: Lamao bamɔi ba Batikasa la BaFalusi loongana lande, iyo mbo— Tolɛmbi nde ndɔɛnɛ ndembe end’Aɛ.
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

lokele: Kongo ko Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— Fɛtɔ-ye ya obe la nyongo basokaluke ndembe ya ikesa, nde angwɛnɛ ango ɛmwito kofomo iyo, sakolo ngo ko ndembe ya Yona ewa Bɔtɔndɔli.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

lokele: Eoka kwa ayalaka Yona la becho la njowa bisatɔ nda sɔlɔ ya engää ya swi, ko ongoma Wana-wa-Boto eyalaka nda nyɛlɛ ko becho la njowa bisatɔ.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

lokele: Bato ba Ninewe batoemesana la bato ba fɛtɔ-ye yanu nda lise lia Likomyi, la iyo batof’ino se, eoka iyo nd’akalanganäkä eoka ya inango sha Yona, nde tɛnɛngɔ oyalongeli Yona ngo ko eyamaya.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

lokele: Bokɔta otomali wa yese ya Sheba atoemesana la e-fɛtɔ-ye nda lise lia Likomyi, la atof’iyo se, eoka asekwäkä olo nda liko lia wenda ndoyoka wɛlï wa Solomo, nde tɛnɛngɔ oyalongeli nde Solomo ngo ko eyamaya.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

lokele: Bolimo wa lilo bosekwa to ende boto, wao atotandela bilela ebiti la balia okaluke fofe yolengela omao, kongo ko angotɛnɛ yao;
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

lokele: Lamao inde koonga mbo— Itoinwa nda ndakɔ yami olo asekweliki’mi. Akayek’inde omao, atosha yao fololo, ani esɔmbɔmɔ la esokomyomo.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

lokele: Limɔ atɔkɛ okɔsɔ belimo osambale yasi ebisoet’inde la obe, la iyo yaatotina kɔɔtɔkɔ ndakɔ okayalaka ina, la boyaeli wa mbisa wa oto ona bosoetela ewa oso la bobe. Loyalaka ko ongoma imɔ la e-fɛtɔ-ye ya obe.
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

lokele: Atitasiläkä Yesu ndoonga la bikuke ya bato, nyango la bitungani yande loemala lousa, iyo lolɛmbɛ ndoyaongana lande;
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

lokele: Oto ɔmɔi loonga lande mbo— Tɛnɛ nyango waɛ la bitungani yaɛ basoemalaka lousa, balɛmbi ndoyaongana laɛ.
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutola lande mbo— ¿Ndai ale nyango wami? ¿Bandai bende bitungani yami?
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lonanola bosamba wande ende baeki bande, Inde mbo— Tɛnɛ, nyango wami la bitungani yami.
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

lokele: Inde oyatokela kwa alɛmbi Sango wami oyayali nda Use, ambo inde nd’ale etungani yami la welo wami la nyango wami.
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

lokele: Nda lise lina asekwäkä Yesu nda ndakɔ, Inde loyala se nda ngɔngɛ ya eliya,
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

lokele: la bikuke bifi fafo lolingel’Inde; eokao Inde lokwa nda watɔ, Inde loyala se omao ani bato loemala nda ngɔngɛ.
english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

lokele: Inde loekes’iyo njasɔ wike kola bembila, mbo— Tɛnɛ, bɔlɔi ɔmɔi lɔkɛ okalɔɔ koto;
english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

lokele: alɔɔkɔ inde koto ongoma, bimɔi lokwa nda mboka, la nɔli loya oyala yao;
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

lokele: la yasi bimɔi lokwa nda elela olo ayali batalɛ, angwɛnɛ nyɛlɛ wike, yao lɔɔ̈tɔ̈ lisasaya eoka ya nyɛlɛ yotalangu.
english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

lokele: Nde ayäkä löwa ifitika, yao lokofa la njöwa, yao lobɛɛkɛlɛ fɛɛ eoka angwɛnɛ biili.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

lokele: La yasi bimɔi lokwa nda kɛ̈kɛ̈ limɔ kɛ̈kɛ̈ lɔɔ̈tɔ̈ la kɛ̈kɛ̈ lɔnyɛlɛ koto,
english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

lokele: Nde yasi bimɔi lokwa nda nyɛlɛ ilau, yao lɔɔ̈tɔ̈, yao lota tuma, bimɔi kama liu, bimɔi kama liambɛ, bimɔi kama isatɔ.
english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

lokele: Oyayali la batoi, okeke.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

lokele: Lamao baeki loya end’Inde, iyo mbo— ¿Monito otoonga lau la bembila?
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

lokele: Inde lomutola lau mbo— End’ino kongo, njasɔ ebisoisomo ya Bɔkɔta wa Use, yao koisolomo, kongo ko ende iyo bitiisolomo.
english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

lokele: Eoka boto oyaɔli efomoko nde yasi, la eyalaka nde la ngɔnyi; nde boto oyatiɔlɛ ɛɔnɔkɔlɔmɔkɔ yao ebiɔliki inde.
english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

lokele: Eokao itoonga lau la bembila, eoka batɛnɛ ko liɛnɛ̈lɛ̈; batoka liokɛ̈lä, angolüwa litina.
english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

lokele: End’iyo litɔndɔli lia Yesaya lisokɔchɔmɔ, mbo— La batoi, ino bokaka, nde angolüwa litina; La baiso, ino botichaka, nde angotɛnɛ swa.
english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

lokele: Eoka betema ya etukela-ye bisokwelo itɔka, La batoi bau batooka ko ilao kongo, La basolinjaka baiso bau ndi, Mbo bataɛnɛ la baiso, la bataoka la batoi, Batalüwaka batina la betema la batakalangana, La mbo itauwes’iyo.
english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’ Isaiah 6:9-10

lokele: Nde baiso banu nd’asofota eoka basɔɛnɛ; la batoi imɔ, eoka basooka.
english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

lokele: Wewe, isoonga lanu mbo— Batɔndɔli wike la eba liengani wike balɛmbɛkɛ finɛ ndɔɛnɛ ebisɔɛnɛ ino, nde batiɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ yao; la ndooka ebisook’ino, nde batiaokäkä yao.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

lokele: Okaka to litina lia bombila wa bɔlɔi.
english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

lokele: Atooka boto lioi lia Bɔkɔta wa Use, angoosha to litina, limɔ Ewa Obe ako Satana atoyaɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ koto ebilɔɔmuku nda botema wande. Wao end’inde oyalɔɔmɔkɔ nda mboka.
english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

lokele: Inde oyalɔɔmɔkɔ nda elela ya batalɛ ende oto oyatooka lioi lisasaya la limɛngɔ;
english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

lokele: kongo ko ati la biili ndatiteni yande nde koumwaka ko mbile sinyo; limɔ atoya tale la likongolomu eoka ya Lioi, lisasaya atokwa se.
english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

lokele: Inde imɔ oyalɔɔmɔkɔ nda kɛ̈kɛ̈, atooka Lioi, bifembi ya wenda la lilimbi lia bieto, bitoyanyɛɛlɛ Lioi, angota tuma.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

lokele: Nde inde oyalɔɔmɔkɔ nda nyɛlɛ ilau atooka Lioi, atoosh’imɔ litina lia Lioi, atota tuma, bimɔi kama liu, bimɔi kama liambɛ, bimɔi kama isatɔ. Koto ilau la Koto ibe
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

lokele: Yesu lotamb’iyo bombila wasi, Inde mbo— Bɔkɔta wa Use kokwelomo la boto oyalɔɔkɔ koto bilau kwa bangwindi nda elanga yande,
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

lokele: nde aingalaka bato tɔlɔ, wiyani lande loya oyalɔɔ baoköoko ko omao nda koto ya bangwindi, limɔ inde lotangwa eyande.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds 13:25 also among the wheat, and went away.

lokele: Nde ɔtɔkɔ yao batɔmbɔ, lamao ko baoköoko imɔ lɔɛnɛlɛ.
english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

lokele: La bɛkɔwa ya ngɛnɛ w’elanga loya ayaonga lande mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, mbo aɛ otialɔ̈ɔ̈kɔ̈ koto ilau nda elanga yaɛ? ¿Baoköoko basokwi to nde lonima?
english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

lokele: Inde mbo— Wiyani nd’asokela ongoma. Lamao bɛkɔwa loonga lande mbo— Olɛmbi to mbo iso tɔɛkɛ okasɔnjaka bao?
english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

lokele: Nde inde mbo— Mbayɔ, eoka mbo atosɔnjak’ino baoköoko, otauwokola imɔ ko bangwindi lisanga.
english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

lokele: Machaka yaambale bikondakaneke konda mbile ya eula, lamao nda eula, imi koonga la ebatotwa mbo— Tasɔnjakɛ baoköoko, ndokandaka bao bekuku yofechomo limɔ sɔnjaka bangwindi nda ekukelo yami. Bembila yasi yokweekela Bɔkɔta wa Use
english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

lokele: Inde lotamb’iyo bombila wasi, Inde mbo— Bɔkɔta wa Use bole kwa lokoto loa mbase, boto lɔsɔ loao, inde lolɔɔ loao nda elanga yande;
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

lokele: lole lokoto lokɛkɛ loeta bitoti la bɔkɛkɛ, kongo ko atokonda loao, lotolongela tosasandu tototina, lotoya isandu angɛnɛ mbo nɔli biyeke oyakelaka bikalingo yau nda beta ya shao.
english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

lokele: Inde lokambes’iyo bombila wasi, mbo— Bɔkɔta wa Use wende kwa fulofulo eyundi otomali ndokaisa nda kilo isato ya lɔkɛ̈kɛ̈ (eoka yokela lituma) mbo bitotina biulweke la fulofulo.
english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures 13:33 of meal, until it was all leavened.”

lokele: Bitotina-bi Yesu loonga ende bikuke ya bato ko la bembila, la Inde angoonga lau sakolo ko la bombila
english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

lokele: ongoma lioi eliaongaka bɔtɔndɔli liakɔchɔmɔkɔ mbo— Itoasola bɔnɔkɔ wami ko ndokusola bombila, Itoongaka yao ebiisamiki konda liako lia wenda ko louse.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.” Psalms 78:2

lokele: Lamao Inde lomacha bikuke ya bato, Inde lɔɔtɔ ndakɔ la baeki bande loya end’Inde, iyo mbo— Sanoelak’iso litina lia bombila eoka ya baoköoko nda elanga.
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

lokele: Yesu loonga mbo— Bɔlɔi wa koto bilau ende Wana wa Boto,
english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

lokele: elanga ende ewenda-bo, koto bilau bende bana ba Bɔkɔta wa Use; nde baoköoko bende bana ba Ewa obe;
english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

lokele: wiyani oyalɔɔkɔ bao ale Satana; eula yende basilelo ba wenda, ebatotwa eula bende bakitomo.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

lokele: Kwa asɔnjɔmɔkɔ baoköoko ndokafechomo nda bosä, ko ongoma akakelomoko nda basilelo ba wenda.
english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

lokele: Wana wa Boto elatomaka bakitomo bande la iyo belasɔnjaka nda yakakaelo yande bitotina ebitobebekesa bato la ebatokelaka obe,
english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

lokele: la belaumbokolaka iyo nda bosa wa litumbo, olo elayalaka bileli la ngɛlɛtɛ ya bainyo.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

lokele: Lamao bato ba liengani belaangangaka kwa löwa nda Bɔkɔta wa Sango wau. Oyale la batoi, okeke. Yeka ya loketi lofi fafo
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

lokele: Bɔkɔta wa Use bole kwa bieto ya mbiso ebisoisomo nda elanga; aisoläkä oto oisola yao, inde loisa yao liasi, limɔ eoka ya limɛngɔ, inde lɔkɛ okaungesa biengo yande bitotina, inde kosomba elanga ena.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

lokele: Liasi imɔ, Bɔkɔta wa Use bole kwa botimbi wa bokalala oyatokalüke maka (eko sheka sha loketi lofi fafo);
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

lokele: limɔ ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ inde lomaka loa loketi loa likama, inde lɔkɛ okatambesa biengo bitotina, inde losomba loao.
english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

lokele: Liasi imɔ, Bɔkɔta wa Use bole kwa wɛngɔ ebosotomo nda balia, wao loobyamela swi ya befɔnɔ bitotina,
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

lokele: akatumeke wao, iyo kosamba nda ngɔngɛ, iyo loyala se mbo baönyeke ebilau nda bembeya, ani iyo koumbola ebibe tubu.
english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

lokele: Lolayalaka ko ongoma nda basilelo ba wenda; bakitomo bekuswaka ndoönya bato babe la eba liengani shɛi,
english: So it will be in the end of the world. 13:49 The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

lokele: la beumbolaka iyo nda bosä wa litumbo, olo elayalaka bileli la ngɛlɛtɛ ya bainyo.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Osoluwa litina lia bitotina-bi? Iyo mbo— Eingo.
english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu loonga lau mbo— Eokao luwaka mbo Botikasa oyale boeki wa Bɔkɔta wa Use, ende kwa ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ oyatokusokola boindä wa oso la biɛngɔ biyai imɔ, nda bondanda ebole lande. Fee ya eba Nasaleta
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

lokele: Asiläkä Yesu ndotel’iyo bembila-bi, Inde losekwa omao.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

lokele: Iyäkä Inde nda tukela yande angɛnɛ, Inde loekekes’iyo nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ yau, iyo lomwaala, iyo mbo— ¿Boto-yo asɔɔlɔ wɛlï-bo la bisisho ya bofoka ko anima to?
english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

lokele: ¿Ati nde bɔkwɛti-bo? ¿Nyango wande ati to la lina liko Maliya? ¿Bitungani yande bati to eba Yakobo la Yosefa la Simona la Yuda?
english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas? 13:55

lokele: ¿Baelo bande batotina bati to lasu eya? ¿Boto-yo asɔɔlɔ bitotina-bi ko anima?
english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

lokele: La iyo lɔɛnɛ ko tale eoka yande. Nde Yesu loonga lau mbo— Bɔtɔndɔli atolitesomo sakolo ngo ko nda bokenge wande angɛnɛ la nda ndakɔ yande angɛnɛ.
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

lokele: Atiakeläkä bisisho ya bofoka wike omao eoka batiäkä la liimeli.
english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

lokele: Nda mbile-ao Bɔkɔta Helodi Antipas wa Ngalilai looka lokuku loa Yesu.
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

lokele: Inde loonga la bɛkɔwa yande mbo— Boto-yo ende Yoane Bolufi, asokuswa nda liwa, eokao befoka bitokekaka bisisho ko lande.
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

lokele: Nde Helodi aundesäkä Yoane, inde lokandak’inde, inde lot’inde nda ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, loasɔ loa Helodia wali wa boloo wande ako Filipo.
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

lokele: Eoka Yoane aongäkä la Helodi mbo— Etiengane la bikela mbo ɔɔsɛk’inde ndosɔng’inde.
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

lokele: Asangäkä nde ndool’inde, kongo ko inde lowanga bikuke ya bato eoka iyo lotanga Yoane mbo bɔtɔndɔli.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

lokele: Nde ayäkä lise lioenyela liotomu lia Helodi, boseka wa Helodia loinel’iyo bisha, inde loomalesa Helodi.
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

lokele: Lamao Helodi lotikel’inde lisakä ko la tele mbo atofa boseka yeka eyekombeke inde.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

lokele: Lamao boseka, oyasoluwesomo ko oso la nyango wande, inde loonga mbo— Faka’mi ko eya botö wa Yoane Bolufi nda lotufa.
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

lokele: Helodi okäkä ikɛnɛnɛ sifi, kongo ko eoka ya tele yande, la eoka ya ebayaläkä lande nda bieka, inde loonga lau mbo wao bofomoko end’inde.
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

lokele: Limɔ Helodi lotoma boto ndokatena botö wa Yoane nda ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

lokele: Inde loesha botö nda lotufa, inde lofa boseka wao, la boseka lɔkɛ la wao ende nyango wande.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

lokele: La baeki ba Yoane loya, iyo loila engulunguma, iyo loomba yao, lamao iyo lɔkɛ lokakambesa Yesu. Lilesi lia bato bilɛfu bɔɔmwi
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

lokele: Okaka Yesu mboli-bi, Inde losokwa omao ko la watɔ, okakɛ nda elela eyele elämbä ko Inde angɛnɛ; nde okäkä bikuke ongoma iyo lokuswakuswaka nda kenge okatutane lande la bakolo.
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

lokele: Asaowäkä Yesu Inde lɔɛnɛ windi bofi wa bato, Inde lookel’iyo ngandi; la Inde louwekesa ebau ba biale.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

lokele: Aɔngɔkɔ buse litele, baeki bande loyaonga lande mbo— Elela-ye ende ko isimo la buse bosɔngɔ; machaka windi w’ato baɛkɛ nda bekenge okasomba bieka.
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lau mbo— Bati la litina liosekwa, ino angɛnɛ nd’atof’iyo bieka yola.
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

lokele: Iyo loonga lande mbo— Toti ango la waya, ngo ko beila bɔɔmwi la swi imbale.
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

lokele: Inde mbo— Taeshaka yao eyamaya.
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

lokele: Lamao Inde loonga la windi w’ato mbo bayaleke se nda chwingi chwesi; Inde lɔɔsɔ beila bɔɔmwi la swi imbale, Inde loila baiso likolo, Inde losombola limɔ Inde loataka bao, Inde lofaekefa baeki beila, la baeki lofaekefa windi w’ato.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

lokele: Limɔ batotina lola la iyo lokanelo, la iyo loina twinyo twa beila ebitikali yotumesa bisaka liu la imbale.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

lokele: Bato ana ebaläkä baaka batolome bilɛfu bɔɔmwi, angotanga batomali la bana. Yesu lotanda likolo lia balia
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

lokele: Kwaamao Yesu loonga la baeki bande mbo bakweke nda watɔ la mbo balekeke oso wande ko nda boili wasi, ani Inde atomelesa windi w’ato.
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

lokele: Asenyanak’Inde la windi wa bato, Inde lolila nda löngo ko Inde angɛnɛ okasombola omao. Aɔngɔkɔ buse Inde loyala ko Inde angɛnɛ omao.
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

lokele: Ani watɔ waaka owale la bosofalima la batutu, eoka lofofo losonana lau,
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

lokele: nda mbile ya lilamba lia anɛi (la yombe) Yesu loyel’iyo ani atotanda tandelele likolo lia balia.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, 14:25 Jesus came to them, walking on the sea. See Job 9:8

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ baeki mbo atotanda likolo lia balia, iyo lowanga finɛ, iyo mbo— Ende bosoko, iyo loamama la bɔwa.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lau lisasaya, mbo— Sambolaka betema, ende Imi, owängëke.
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! 14:27 Don’t be afraid.”

lokele: Limɔ Petelo lomutola lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, eyambo ende Aɛ, kambesaka’mi iyeke end’Aɛ tandelele likolo lia balia.
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Yauku. Lamao Petelo lokwa se nda watɔ, inde loakola ndotanda likolo lia balia okakɛ ende Yesu.
english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ inde lömba lofi inde lowänga la inde loakola ndolinda, inde loamama mbo— Ngɛnɛ, uwesaka’mi.
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

lokele: Lisasaya Yesu lonanola bosamba wande, Inde loundes’inde, Inde loonga lande mbo— Aɛ wa liimeli likɛkɛ, otiki to fee eok’iye?
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

lokele: Akwäkä iyo nda watɔ, lofofo lotemba,
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

lokele: limɔ ebayali nda watɔ losemola Inde, iyo mbo— Wewe, Aɛ wende Wana wa Mungu.
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

lokele: Alekäkä iyo, iyo loiyela boili nda Ngeneseleta,
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

lokele: limɔ batolome ba elela ena loleembel’Inde, lamao iyo lotomaka wɛndi nda yese ebitimbi la iyo loeshel’Inde bato batotina ba kambo,
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

lokele: iyo lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Yesu mbo bamateke ango litamba lia esinda yande, la batotina ebamatakäkä liao, iyo losäsekesomo säsosäso.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe 14:36 of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

lokele: Limɔ BaFalusi la Batikasa ba Yelusaleme loya ende Yesu oyafel’Inde mbo—
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

lokele: Monito baeki baɛ batotefola ndola ya bangau? Eoka baitosoola bangasa ani batola bieka.
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— ¿Ino imɔ, monito bototefola Bikela ya Mungu eoka ya ndola yanu?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

lokele: Eoka Mungu nd’aongäkä mbo— Litesaka sango waɛ la nyango waɛ; la imɔ mbo— Oyatomɔlɔ sango kwa nyango wande, aweke wewe.
english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ Exodus 20:12 and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’ Exodus 21:17

lokele: Nde ino nd’atoonga mbo— Boto oyatoonga la sango kwa nyango mbo— Yeka esambɔɔlɔ ino ende’mi, yao ele lifaefi,
english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

lokele: inde angolitesa sango wande la nyango wande. Ongoma ino osotombola Lioi lia Mungu ko la baiti banu ba kwala.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

lokele: Ino ba bolimbakeli, Yesaya atɔndɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ wewe loasɔ loanu nda lokasa loande mbo—
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

lokele: E bato-ba batolitesa’mi la bɛnɔkɔ, Kongo ko betema yau bile esika lami.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

lokele: Batosemola’mi lisemoëlä, Eoka liekesi liau lile ko bikela ya bato.
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’” Isaiah 29:13

lokele: Limɔ Inde lota ekuke ya bato end’Inde, Inde loonga lau mbo— Okaka la lüwak’imɔ mbo,
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

lokele: eti yeka eyetɔɔtɔ nda bɔnɔkɔ w’oto nd’atosɛlɛ inde la bɔwɛwɛ; kangä yao ebitokuswa nda bɔnɔkɔ wande, yao nd’atobebes’inde la bɔwɛwɛ.
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

lokele: Lamao baeki bande loya end’Inde, iyo mbo— ¿Olüwi nde mbo BaFalusi basɔɛnɛ tale finɛ ani asook’iyo e-lioi-li?
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

lokele: Inde lomutola mbo— Litɔmbɔ la litɔmbɔ elitilɔɔmɔ ko la Sango wami, liao litouwolomo fukuku.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

lokele: Machak’iyo, iyo angɛnɛ bende betoli oso ebale imɔ la botuku; boto wa botuku etola ewa botuku oso nda mboka, iyo yaambale kokekelana nda liyöndo.
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

lokele: Limɔ Petelo loya liasi mbo— Sanoelak’iso e-bombila-bo.
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

lokele: Yesu mbo— ¿Ko ino imɔ, oti la liluwani?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

lokele: ¿Mbo, otiluwe mbo yeka eyetɔɔtɔ nda bɔnɔkɔ etoetela ngo nda sɔlɔ, etonyomo nda tɔi.
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

lokele: Kongo ko ebitokusola boto nda bɔnɔkɔ, yao bitosekwa nda botema; yao nd’atosɛlɛ boto la bɔwɛwɛ;
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

lokele: eoka ebitosekwaka nda botema biko yɛmɛ ibe, lioli-lia-boto, nyongo, bolëfë, wiya, liwanjeli, la limɔli.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

lokele: Njasɔ-bi nd’atosɛlɛ boto la bɔwɛwɛ; nde ndola bieka ani bangasa batitasoolomo, angosɛlɛ boto la bɔwɛwɛ. Boseka wa yese yasi louwesomökö
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

lokele: Asekwäkä Yesu omao, Inde lɔkɛ nda bolelo wa yese ya Tulo la Sidona.
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

lokele: Kwaamao botomali wa Kanana oyasekwi nda bolelo wa yese ena, inde loyamama mbo— Okelaka’mi ngandi sumbu, Aɛ Ngɛnɛ, Wana wa Dawidi, wana wami otomali atookesomoko wale finɛ la bolimo obe.
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

lokele: Nde Yesu angomutoela otomali lioi ango limɔi. Baeki bande loya oyaomb’Inde mbo— Kɛsɛk’inde, atangweke eoka atoamama ombisa yasu.
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutola mbo— Itiatomomökö sakolo ko ende bɛkɔkɔ ebalefani ya bofindi wa Isalaele.
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

lokele: Limɔ otomali loyaswa balui se oso wande, inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ sungaka’mi.
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola mbo— Etiengane ndɔɔnɔkɔlɔ lituma lia bana okakushela ngwa.
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

lokele: Nde inde mbo— Eingo Ngɛnɛ, ko ngwa kongo bitolaka bakɔmbɔ ba lituma ebatokwaka ose ya mɛsa ya ngɛnɛ wa yao.
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Botomali, liimeli liaɛ lile lifi. Loyaleke end’aɛ kwa asolɛmbɛ aɛ. La wana wande losäsesomo ko la mbil’ao.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

lokele: Yesu losekwa omao, Inde lɔkɛ tina la eliya ya Ngalilai, lamao Inde lolila nda löngo, Inde loyala se ko omao.
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

lokele: Limɔ bikuke ya bato loya end’Inde, iyo loeshakela Inde bato ba bikoti, l’eba betuku, l’eba biuma, l’ebalɛmbɛtɛki, la basi imɔ, la bato lot’iyo se nda bakolo ba Yesu la Inde losäsekes’iyo;
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

lokele: eokao ekuke ya bato lomwaala ani ɛnɛk’iyo eba biuma batoongaka, ebalɛmbɛtɛki basɔɔlɔ bosäsu, eba bikoti batɔkɛndɛ, eba betuku batɔɛnɛ, limɔ iyo losemola Mungu wa Isalaele. Lilesi lia bato bilɛfu binɛi
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

lokele: Lamao Yesu lota baeki bande lioi, Inde loonga lau mbo— Isookela bikuke ya bato ngandi, eoka basoumwaka lami kwani ko becho isatɔ la bati la yeka yola, itilɛmbɛ ndokɛsɛ iyo eyau ko la isiye mbo batawa boleka nda mboka.
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

lokele: La baeki bande loonga lande mbo— ¿Totoosha nd’anima beila boengana ekuke efi ya bato nda e-isimo-si?
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Ole la beila yanga? Iyo mbo— Bosambale la toswiswi tɔmɔi.
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

lokele: Inde loonga la windi wa bato mbo bayaleke se nda nyɛlɛ,
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

lokele: Inde lɔɔsɔ beila bosambale la toswiswi, Inde lofa kelekëlë, Inde loataka bao, Inde lofaekefa baeki bande la baeki lokafaekefe bato.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

lokele: Iyo atotina lola, iyo lɔtɛkwa; iyo loina twinyo etwatikaläkä, iyo lotumesa bisaka osambale.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

lokele: Bato ebaläkä baaka batolome bilɛfu binɛi, angotanga batomali la bana.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

lokele: Inde lɔkɛsɛ bato eyau, Inde lokwa nda watɔ, limɔ Inde loiya nda tukela ya Mangandala.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

lokele: BaFalusi la BaSadoke loya ende Inde ndoyakotel’Inde; bafelak’Inde mbo ɛnɛsɛk’iyo ikesa sha Use kwa ndembe.
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

lokele: Inde mbo— Nda baɔndwɛlɔ ba use otoonga mbo— Lɛlɛngɔ buse botosangwa eoka kwani olikolo liende litelu.
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

lokele: Ango ko la nɔngɔ, otoonga mbo— Louse buse botofinyaka eoka olikolo liende litelu la shɔmbɛ. Oluwi nde ndolembeela ndembe ya buse, nde otikɔkɔlɛ ndolembeela ndembe ya mbile-ye.
english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

lokele: Fɛtɔ-ye ya obe la lieyaeya batolukaka ndembe, nde angwɛnɛ angɔmwito kofomo iyo, sakolo ngo ko ndembe ya Yona. Limɔ Inde lomach’iyo, Inde lɔkɛ.
english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

lokele: Alekäkä baeki nda fangi yasi, iyo loosala ndotola lituma.
english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— Tɛnɛkɛ la wɛlï mbo oengweke lisoo lia lituma lia BaFalusi la BaSadoke.
english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

lokele: Iyo lofelana mbo— Eoka totitole lituma?
english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

lokele: Aluwäkä Yesu ongoma, Inde loonga lau mbo— Ee, ino ba liimeli likɛkɛ, ¿Monito otofelana mbo oti la lituma?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

lokele: Okaluwi kɔni litina? Otienyele batuma bɔɔmwi bokaela bato bilɛfu bɔɔmwi, wainäkä bisaka yanga?
english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

lokele: ¿Otienyele imɔ batuma bosambale bokaela bato bilɛfu inɛi, wainäkä belanga yanga?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

lokele: ¿Monito otiluweke mbo itionge lanu loasɔ loa lituma? Kangä mbo oengweke lisoo lia lituma lia BaFalusi la BaSadoke.
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo loluwaka mbo Yesu ationge lau mbo baengweke lisoo lia lituma angɛnɛ, kangä liekesi lia BaFalusi la BaSadoke. Yesu akuliomökö mbo Masiya
english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

lokele: Iyaka Yesu nda yese ya Kaisalia ya Filipo, Inde lofela baeki bande mbo— ¿Bato batoonga mbo Wana wa Boto ende ndai?
english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Bamɔi mbo Yoane Bolufi, bamɔi mbo Eliya, basi mbo Yelemaya ango ko ɔmɔi wa batɔndɔli.
english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Nde ino nd’atoonga mbo Imi yende ndai?
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

lokele: Simona Petelo lomutola mbo— Aɛ wende Masiya, Wana wa Mungu wa Liwawi.
english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lande mbo— Wende la limɛngɔ Simona, wana wa Yona, eoka ati boto wa bindo la bakila oyasoluwes’aɛ loasɔ-lo, kangä Sango wami oyayali nda Use.
english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

lokele: La Imi nd’atoonga laɛ mbo— Aɛ wende to Petelo Petelo mbo Litale la nda litalɛ-li itoswa Etanda yami, la biome ya eyaelo ya ebasowa biitolongela yao.
english: I also tell you that you are Peter, 16:18 and on this rock 16:18 I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades 16:18 will not prevail against it.

lokele: Itofaef’aɛ fungola ya Bɔkɔta wa Use, la yeka ena eyekakandek’aɛ ono nda wenda, yao ekandomoko nda Use, la yeka ena eyekafaikol’aɛ ono nda wenda, yao efaikolomoko nda Use.
english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

lokele: Lamao Inde loima baeki bande mbo bataluwesa boto angɔmwito mbo Inde ende Masiya.
english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

lokele: Ko nda mbile ena Yesu loakola ndoisoela baeki bande mbo lole end’Inde mbo atakɛndɛkɛ nda Yelusaleme la ndokesomo biale wike kola biange la kanga ebieti la batikasa la ndoolomo imɔ la mbo atɛmwɛsɔmɔkɔ mbisa ya becho isato.
english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

lokele: Limɔ Petelo lounda Yesu, inde loakola ndoimak’Inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, lɔmɛsɛlɔmɔkɔ end’Aɛ, mbo loasɔ-lo lotaya end’Aɛ.
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lokikwa ende Petelo, Inde mbo— Etaka ombisa yami Satana, otoola’mi likulya eoka botema waɛ botienyele njasɔ ya Mungu kangä eya bato.
english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu loonga la baeki bande mbo— Boto ɛlɛmbɛ mbo atuteke’mi atafekelek’inde angɛnɛ, atatolaka lieka liande la atuteke’mi.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

lokele: Eoka mbo oyatolɛmbɛ ndoikesa liwawi liande angɛnɛ, atolefesa nde liao; kongo ko oyatolefesa liwawi liande eoka yami, inde nd’atoikesa liao.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

lokele: ¿Boto ɛɔlɔkɔ bitotina ya wenda-bo, nde kolefesa liwawi liande angɛnɛ, asɔɔlɔ to iye? ¿Boto afeke eni to yeka yofangola la liwawi liande angɛnɛ?
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

lokele: Eoka Wana wa Boto elayaka la tala la liomala lia Sango wande amamwito la bakitomo bande; lamao Inde atɔɔlɛsɛ boto la boto bondanda woengana la bekeeli yande.
english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

lokele: Isoonga lanu wewe mbo— Bato bamɔi ebemali eyamaya, batiawëkë konda akɛnɛk’iyo Wana wa Boto oyaɔsɔ Bɔkɔta.
english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho liambɛ, Yesu lɔɔsɔ Petelo, la Yakobo, la etungani ya Yakobo ako Yoane, Inde lɔkɛsɛnɛ lau olikolo lia löngo lofi, ko iyo angɛnɛ kongo;
english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

lokele: limɔ Inde lokindolomo bɔfɔnɔ wasi oso wa baiso bau, la bɔmbɔ wande longalikima kwa löwa, la bisinda yande imɔ lolangema langelele.
english: He was changed 17:2 before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

lokele: Futuku Mɔsɛ la Eliya lɔɛnɛlɛ ani batoongana la Yesu.
english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

lokele: Lamao Petelo loonga la Yesu mbo— Ngɛnɛ, ende bolau end’iso ndoyala eyamaya, Aɛ bɔlɛmbɛ, isweke ono kumbo bisatɔ, ɛmɔi yaɛ, ɛmɔi ya Mɔsɛ, ɛmɔi ya Eliya.
english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

lokele: Angotasila ndoonga, lifita lia bolangalanga loyaisa iyo, la limiki lookana nda lifita, mbo— Oyo ende Wana wami wa losamɔ, oyatoomalesa’mi, okak’Inde.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

lokele: Okaka baeki lioi-li, iyo loomakana biɔmbɔ la se, iyo lowänga finɛ.
english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

lokele: Nde Yesu loyamata iyo, Inde mbo— Emalaka, owängëke.
english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

lokele: Ilak’iyo baiso, batiɛnɛ̈kɛ imɔ boto, sakolo ko Yesu angɛnɛ.
english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

lokele: Asekwäk’iyo nda löngo, Yesu loimak’iyo mbo— Okambesëke boto angɔmwito ebisoɛnɛlɛ sakolo ko ani Wana wa oto asɔtɛmwa nda liwa.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

lokele: Lamao baeki lofel’Inde mbo— Eok’iye, batikasa batoonga mbo loengani nde mbo Eliya atayaka oso?
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

lokele: La Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Wewe Eliya nd’atoya oso ndoyakɔkɔmɛsɛ bitotina,
english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

lokele: nde Im’itoonga lanu mbo Eliya asoya ndoya, nde iyo batiluwek’inde la basokeel’inde kwa asosang’iyo. Ko ongoma Wana wa boto eokesomoko bowaü ko lau.
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

lokele: Lamao baeki lolüwa mbo aongiki lau loasɔ loa Yoane Bolufi. Louweso loa wana oyaaka la Olimo Obe
english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

lokele: Iyäkä iyo ende bikuke ya bato liasi, boto ɔmɔi loya ende Yesu, inde loswa balui se oso wande, inde mbo—
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

lokele: Ngɛnɛ welaka wana wami botolome shota, eoka ale l’isekakɔkɔ la wale finɛ la mbile la mbile atokwaka nd’ösä, la nda balia imɔ ko ongoma;
english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

lokele: iyiki ende baeki baɛ, nde batikɔkɔlɛkɛ ndouwes’inde.
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lomutola lande mbo— E-fɛtɔ-ye eti la liimeli, esofenyakana nde; ¿itoumwaka lanu ko mbile yanga? ¿Itokɔkɔmɛlɛ ino konda eni mbile? Eshak’inde l’ono ende’mi.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu loimaka bolimo obe, la wao lokuswa, la wana losäsa ko la mbil’ao.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

lokele: Limɔ baeki loya ende Yesu ko iyo angɛnɛ lande, iyo mbo— ¿Iso angokɔkɔlɔ ndokusola wao monito?
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Ko l’eoka ya liimeli lianu likɛkɛ, eoka itoonga lanu wewe mbo— Eya ngo mbo ino boyala la liimeli kwa lokoto lɔmɔi loa mbasɛ, ani ino koonga la e-löngo-lo mbo— Sokwa eya, etak’onamona, la loao kosokwa; angwɛnɛ imɔ loasɔ ango lɔmɔi eloitokɔkɔl’ino okela.
english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

lokele: Ainwäk’iyo nda Ngalilai, Yesu loonga lau mbo— Wana wa boto ewambomoko nda besamba ya bato,
english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

lokele: la batool’Inde, lamao mbisa ya bacho basatɔ, Inde kɔtɛmwɛsɔmɔ liasi. Iyo looka ikɛnɛnɛ sifi.
english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

lokele: Iyäkä iyo nda Kafenauma, basɔnjaki ba lifaefi lia BaYuda loya ende Petelo, iyo mbo— ¿Boekesi wanu atikusole lopata loa lifaefi?
english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins 17:24 came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

lokele: Inde mbo— Eingo. Aɔtɔkɔ Petelo nda ndakɔ, limɔ Yesu lotaonga oso wa Petelo, mbo— ¿Otoenyela to moni, Simona? ¿Bɛkɔta ya wenda-bo batɔɔsɔ bosömbo la bɔsɔmbi ende ndai? ¿Ende bana bau angɛnɛ kwa ende bana ba bɛɛnda?
english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

lokele: Petelo mbo— Ende bɛɛnda. Yesu mbo— Ongoma, bana angɛnɛ angokamba bɔsɔmbi to.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

lokele: Nde eoka mbo totakwesa bato-ba nda litwanelo, takɛndɛkɛ nda ngɔngɛ ya eliya, taka shuku, la swi eyetotangola shao ani osokɔkɛlɛ, aɛ kɔɔsɔ yao, akalioleke aɛ bɔnɔkɔ wa swi, aɛ koosha lopata lofi; ɔsɔkɔ loao, faefak’iyo loao loasɔ loaɛ lami.
english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. 17:27 Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

lokele: Nda mbile ena baeki loya ende Yesu, iyo lofel’Inde mbo— Ndai yatolongela ofi nda Bɔkɔta wa Use?
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

lokele: Yesu lota wainɛngɛ lioi mbo ayeke end’Inde, lamao Inde loemesa wana sisi yau,
english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

lokele: Inde mbo— Wewe isoonga lanu mbo sakolo ko ino kokikwa okinjwa kwa bana bakɛkɛ, ani ino angɔɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Use.
english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

lokele: Nde wao ona oyatoikamaka se, oto ona asolongela ofi nda Bɔkɔta wa Use.
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

lokele: Oyatonyangela wana ɔmɔi kwa wana-yo, ko l’eoka ya lina liami, inde nd’atonyangela’mi,
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

lokele: nde oyatokwesa wainɛngɛ ɔmɔi oyasoimela’mi, losoeta lande olau mbo litalɛ lifi likandomoko nda kingo yande, la mbo alindesomoko nda balia ba olundu ba eliya.
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

lokele: Aeko wale nda wenda-bo eoka ya njasɔ yokwesaka bato. Yao angotakufaka, nde wale wa liömä boyaka ende boto oyatofɔɔlɔ yao.
english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

lokele: Eokao, lingasa liaɛ, kwa litindi liaɛ, likwes’aɛ, tenaka liao, umbolaka liao tungi, ndɔɔtɔ nda loiko ko eleme kwa ekoti losoeta ɔkɛsɔmɔ nda bösä wofya layalaya ani ole la bangasa bambale la bakolo bambale.
english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

lokele: Eyambo liso liaɛ likwes’aɛ nda obe, ömɔlɔkɔ liao, la umbolaka liao tungi; ndɔɔtɔ nda liwawi ko la liso limwito ko ɛtwɛlɛ kongo, losoeta ɔkɛsɔmɔ nda Ngehena ya bösä la baiso bambale.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna 18:9 of fire.

lokele: La wɛlï to, mbo otaolya ɔmwito wa ebakɛkɛ-ba, eoka Imi nd’asoonga lanu mbo—
english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

lokele: Nda Use bakitomo bau batoɛnɛkɛkɛ bɔmbɔ wa Sango wami lise la lise nda Use.
english: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost. 18:11

lokele: ¿Otoenyela nde moni? Boto eyala la bɛkɔkɔ kama liu; la ɔmwito wa yao kongo elota oeyaeya, inde angomacha yao kama libwa la libwa nda föngo okalukake ona ebosoeyaeya?
english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

lokele: Eya to mbo eoshana la wao, wewe Imi mbo, atoomala nda wao ɔmwito olongela ebimɔi kama libwa la libwa ebitieyaeyeke.
english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

lokele: Ko ongoma liti lisangi lia Sango wanu oyayali nda Use mbo ɔmwito wa ebakɛkɛ-ba asɛɛsɛlɛkɛ.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

lokele: Eyambo booto waɛ, ekeel’aɛ obe, takɛndɛkɛ okɛnɛs’inde litwanelo liande ko ino ambale wisisa; eok’aɛ la wɛlï, ambo osɔɔlɔ booto waɛ liasi.
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

lokele: Nde eya to mbo aitook’aɛ, tafelaka oto wasi kwa bato bambale basi, mbo baɛkɛ laɛ mbo baoi batotina bakɔchɔmɔkɔ ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya bakulyi ambale kwa asatɔ.
english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established. Deuteronomy 19:15

lokele: Efeka ndooka imɔ ko iyo, luwesaka Etanda; efeka ndooka ango Etanda, ayaleke laɛ kwa boto oyati waYuda, ango ewa bɔsɔmbi.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe mbo njasɔ ebitokandak’ino ono se, yao bilakandomoko nda Use; la yao ebitofaikol’ino ono se, yao bilafaikolomoko ona nda Use.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

lokele: Itoonga lanu imɔ liasi mbo— Eyambo bato banu ambale bekuliana ono se eoka ya lɔasɔ lɔmɔi elotosombol’ino, loao lokelomoko ino ko la Sango wami oyayali nda Use.
english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

lokele: Eoka olo atosɔngɔmɔ ambale angoko asatɔ ko l’eoka ya lina liami, ambo Imi yende k’omao sisi yau.
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

lokele: Lamao Petelo loya ende Yesu, inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, booto wami ekeela’mi obe, imɛsɛlɛk’inde bamɛsɛlɛ banga, konda bosambale?
english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

lokele: Yesu mbo— Iitoonga laɛ mbo konda bosambale, kangä konda kama osambale osambale.
english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

lokele: Ko la litina-li Bɔkɔta wa Use botokweelomo la bɔkɔta wa tukela ɛmɔi oyalɛmbɛkɛ ndokomya njasɔ ya belima ya bɛkɔwa yande.
english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

lokele: Aakoläkä Inde ndokomya yao, bɔkɔwa wa oso loeshomo end’inde oyaaka la bolima wa pata bilɛfu liu;
english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents. 18:24

lokele: kongo ko atiyaleke la bieto yokamba, eokao Ngɛnɛ wande lota ndola mbo atambesomoko, lande la wali la bana la bitotina eyaaläkä lande mbo bolima bokambomoko.
english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

lokele: Inde loswa to balui se, inde lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Ngɛnɛ mbo— Ngɛnɛ, lombakelaka’mi sumbu, fa’mi fofe yokamb’aɛ bieto bitotina fɛɛ.
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

lokele: Limɔ Ngɛnɛ wa bɔkɔwa ona lookel’inde ngandi, inde lofaikol’inde, inde lɔmɛsɛl’inde bolima.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

lokele: Kongo ko bɔkɔwa-ao, akuswäkä inde, inde lokatowana la bɔkɔwa wasi booto wande oyaaka lande la bolima wa falanga kama liu. Inde lokusamel’inde la kingo, inde mbo— Kambaka to bolima ebole laɛ;
english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, 18:28 and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

lokele: la bɔkɔwa ebɔmɔi loswa balui se, inde lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ wina mbo— Lombakelaka’mi sumbu, fa’mi fofe yokamb’aɛ bitotina fɛɛ.
english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

lokele: Nde inde lofeka, inde lɔkɛ okat’inde nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, kond’akakambek’inde bolima.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ bɛkɔwa ebamɔi lona elosokel’inde, iyo loka ikɛnɛnɛ sha likama, iyo loyakambesa ngɛnɛ wau bitotina ebikelomu.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

lokele: Lamao ngɛnɛ lot’inde lioi mbo ayeke, inde loonga lande mbo— Aɛ wende bɔkɔwa obe, imi nd’amɛsɛliki aɛ bolima waɛ bototina eoka olɔmbɔkɔliki’mi;
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

lokele: lotiengane laɛ mbo okeeleke bɔkɔwa ona booto waɛ ngandi, kwa okeela’mi aɛ?
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

lokele: Lamao ngɛnɛ wau lowa efango finɛ, inde lɔkɛs’inde ende betingani ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ kond’akakambeke inde bolima bototina fɛɛ.
english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

lokele: Ko ongoma, Sango wami nda Use, ekelaka imɔ end’ino, sakolo ko ino otomɛsɛkɛlɛnɛ oto la oto booto wande nda botema wande.
english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

lokele: Asiläkä Yesu liekesi-li, Inde losokwa nda Ngalilai, Inde lɔkɛ nda liko lia Yudea, nda boili wasi wa Yaledene.
english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

lokele: Bikuke ya bato lotutak’Inde la Inde louwekes’iyo k’omao.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

lokele: BaFalusi loya end’Inde oyafel’Inde felo yokɔtɔlɔ Inde, iyo mbo— ¿Loengani nde la Bikela mbo otolome asokoleke wali’ande la litina elikalɛmbɛk’inde?
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

lokele: Inde lomutoel’iyo mbo— ¿Otitange nde mbo ko nda liako Bokeli akeläkä la botolome la botomali la imɔ mbo—
english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female, Genesis 1:27

lokele: eokao botolome atomacha nde sango la nyango’ande la atowatema la wali’ande, la iyo yaambale batoyala oto (bindo) ɔmwito?
english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’? Genesis 2:24

lokele: Kwanyɔ bat’imɔ imbale, kanga bindo ɛmwito. Eokao eyesowacha Mungu, bato angowatola yao.
english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

lokele: Iyo loonga lande mbo— Eokao, monito Mose atäkä ndola mbo olome afeke wali lokasa losenyana la ndosokol’inde?
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Ko l’eoka ya betema yanu bewaü, Mose nd’amacheläk’ino ndosokola bali banu, kongo ko nda liako litiaaka ongoma.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

lokele: Itoonga lanu mbo— Boto oyatosokola wali’ande, sakolo ko l’eoka ya nyongo, la kosɔngɔ wasi, inde nd’atochwela wali’ande nyongo.
english: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

lokele: Baeki bande mbo— Eya to mbo loyala ongoma la olome la wali’ande, loti to lolau ndosɔngɔ.
english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

lokele: Nde Inde loonga lau mbo— Bato batotina angoöndo okulia lioi-li, kangä ko ebasofomo isosha.
english: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

lokele: Bamɔi to bende bitenga eoka baotomökö ongoma, bamɔi basosɛlɔmɔ ani ko la bato, bamɔi basoyales’iyo angɛnɛ ongoma ko l’eoka ya Bɔkɔta wa Use. Boto oyasokɔkɔlɔ okulia lioi-li akulieke to liao. Yesu la bainɛngɛ
english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

lokele: Lamao bana bakɛkɛ loeshelomo end’Inde mbo atalieke iyo bangasa bande la mbo asomboelek’iyo, nde baeki loimaka bato ana;
english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

lokele: nde Yesu mbo— Machaka bana bakɛkɛ bayeke ende’mi, okufesëk’iyo, eoka Bɔkɔta wa Use wende ende bɔfɔnɔ-bo.
english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

lokele: Lamao Inde lotaliaka iyo bangasa limɔ Inde losokwa omao. Boto wa Lifoka
english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

lokele: Futuku boto ɔmɔi loyela Yesu, inde mbo— Boekesi, ikeleke to loni lolau mbo yɔ̈lɛkɛ loiko loa layalaya?
english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Monito otofela’mi loasɔ loa bolau? Angwɛnɛ ango ɔmɔi olau sakolo ko Mungu angɛnɛ, nde boyala la yɛmɛ yɔɔtɔ nda liwawi, litesaka to Bikela;
english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? 19:17 No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

lokele: boto loonga lande mbo— ¿Bini to Bikela? Yesu mbo— Wolëke boto, Ochwëke nyongo, Wiyëke, Otëke nanga,
english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

lokele: Litesaka sango waɛ la nyango waɛ, Samaka boyalani laɛ kwa aɛ angɛnɛ.
english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ Exodus 20:12-16 And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’” Leviticus 19:18

lokele: Isenge sina loonga mbo— Isolitesa bikela-bi bitotina, ¿Loni to imɔ loasɔ eloomelu nde’mi?
english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Bɔlɛmbɛ ndɔɔlɔlɔ hɔlɔ, takɛndɛkɛ okatambesa ebiomani laɛ, faefaka yao ende bato touwe, -ongoma otɔɔlɔ bondanda nda Use— limɔ yauku, tutaka’mi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

lokele: Okäka isenge e-lioi-li, inde lɔkɛ la ikɛnɛnɛ nda botema eoka aaka lifoka lia likama.
english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

lokele: Yesu loonga nde la baeki bande mbo— Wewe, itoonga lanu mbo ende la owaü ende oto wa lifoka ndɔɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Use.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

lokele: Itoonga imɔ lanu mbo bowaü wa ngamela woeta nda lifola lia iolo, botiengane la bowaü wa oto wa lifoka ndɔɔtɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Okäkä baeki bande ongoma, iyo lomwaala finɛ, iyo mbo— ¿Ndai to atokɔkɔlɔ ouwesomo?
english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

lokele: Nde Yesu lotingana lau, Inde mbo— Lona losolongela bato, kongo ko Mungu atokɔkɔlɔ bitotina.
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

lokele: Lamao Petelo lomutola la Yesu mbo— ¿Tɛnɛ, toisomacha bitotina yasu la toisotutak’aɛ, eokao iso kɔɔlɔ to iye?
english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Wewe, itoonga lanu mbo ino ebasotutaka’mi, akayaleke Wana wa Boto nda kɛka ya tala yande, nda baotelomu liasi lia wenda, ino imɔ bolayalaka amao nda kangala liu la imbale ndokomia tukela liu la imbale ya BaIsalaele;
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

lokele: la boto la boto oyamachi ndakɔ kwa baloo kwa baelo, kwa sango, kwa nyango, kwa bana, kwa bilanga, ko l’eoka yami, ɛɔlɔkɔ nde kama liu ya yao ina la loiko loa layalaya lisangai
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

lokele: Nde wike ebale betoli oso bende ko mbisa, la eba mbisa betolaka oso.
