english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

lokele: Bɔkɔta wa Use bole kwa boto, wange wa bɔkɔkɔ, oyakuswäkä la yömbe okaluka basali bokela likuwa nda elanga yande ya tuma.
english: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

lokele: Limɔ akulianäk’inde la basali bamɔi ndokamb’iyo lise la lise lofalanga, inde lotom’iyo nda elanga yande nda likuwa.
english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius 20:2 a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

lokele: Tina la bonyanya oku inde lokuswa liasi, inde lɔɛnɛ basi bemakali ko wawa nda liöngo;
english: He went out about the third hour, 20:3 and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

lokele: inde loonga lau mbo— Ino imɔ kɛndɛkɛ nda elanga limɔ itofaef’ino bieto ebiengani. Iyo lɔkɛ.
english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

lokele: Tina la ifitika la tina la lilöngolöngo imɔ inde lokuswaka ndokakela ko ongoma.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, 20:5 and did likewise.

lokele: Akuswäk’inde liasi tina la baɔngɛlɔ ba use inde loosha basi bemakali wawa, inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Monito ino otoemakalaka ani ko la nɔngɔ buse tuu ko liemaëlä?
english: About the eleventh hour 20:6 he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

lokele: Iyo mbo— Eoka angwɛnɛ boto oyatof’iso likuwa. Inde mbo— Ino imɔ kɛndɛkɛ nda elanga.
english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

lokele: Iläkä buse litele, ngɛnɛ wa elanga loonga la kapita yande mbo— Taka basali lioi, faefak’iyo bɔsɛɛli; akolaka l’eba liili limɔ l’eba oso.
english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

lokele: Ayäkä ebaoshomökö nda baɔngɛlɔ ba use baɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ boto la boto lofalanga.
english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

lokele: Nde ayäkä eba oso iyo loenyela mbo batɔɔlɔ eyoeta, nde iyo imɔ lɔɔlɔ boto la boto lofalanga ko lɔmɔi.
english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

lokele: Aɔsɔ̈kɔ̈ iyo loao, iyo loimaima ngɛnɛ, mbo—
english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

lokele: Eba ba liili bakeli likuwa ko saa ɛmwito kongo, nde osoenganes’iyo lasu ebasotendekela bofimbi wa likuwa la efanga ya löwa.
english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

lokele: Nde ngɛnɛ lomutoela ɔmɔi wau mbo— Wina, itikeel’aɛ loasɔ; mbo aɛ otikulianeke lami nda lofalanga lɔmɔi?
english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

lokele: Ɔsɔkɔ eloaɛ, kɛndɛkɛ eyaɛ; lisangi liami lile ndof’iyo ba liili kwani asofa’mi ofaef’aɛ.
english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

lokele: ¿Mbo lotiengane lami okela kwa asangi nde’mi la eyami angɛnɛ?
english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

lokele: ¿Wende la lisiela ko eoka imi yende bolau? Ongoma, ewa liili etolaka oso, l’ewa oso etungaka liili. Nda mboka yɔkɛ Yelusaleme
english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

lokele: Asangäka Yesu ndɔkɛ Yelusaleme, Inde lɔɔsɔ eba liu la ambale ko wisakumbo nda mboka, Inde loonga lau mbo—
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

lokele: Tɛnɛ, tosɔkɛ Yelusaleme, lamao Wana wa oto atowambomo ende kanga ebieti la batikasa, iyo ana batof’Inde se, mbo aolomoko,
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

lokele: limɔ batɔkɛs’Inde ende bato ba yese yasi, batek’Inde kungutu, baomek’Inde fimbo, la mbo bolek’Inde nda liyeka la mbisa ya becho isatɔ atouwa liasi. Liömbi lia Yakobo la Yoane
english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

lokele: Lamao nyango wa bana batolome ba Sebedayo loya amamwito la bana bande, inde loswa balui se oso wande la inde lofel’Inde loasɔ.
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nd’iye? Otomali loonga lande mbo— Lɛmbɛlɛkɛ mbo ebana-ba bami bambale bayaleke se, ɔmɔi nda osamba wa wali, ɔmɔi nda osamba wa olome, eyalayalek’Aɛ nda Bɔkɔta waɛ.
english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

lokele: Nde Yesu lomutoel’inde mbo— Otiluwe elosofel’aɛ. ¿Otokɔkɔlɔ nde ndomwa kɔpɔ eyetomwa’mi? Iyo loonga lande mbo— Totokɔkɔlɔ.
english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— Ino bomwaka nde kɔpɔ yami nde ndoyales’ino nda bosamba wami w’olome la nda ewa wali, loti loami ndof’ino, kangä ende ebasotonjelomo loao ko la Sango wami.
english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

lokele: Okäkä eba liu ebaoi-ba, iyo losoma la bana-ba bambale.
english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lot’iyo lioi bayeke end’Inde, la Inde loonga lau mbo— Oluwi mbo betoli oso ya ebati BaYuda batokakales’iyo la bato bafi bau bende l’isosha end’iyo.
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

lokele: End’ino, loti ongoma, kongo ko oyatolɛmbɛ mbo ayaleke boto bofi wanu, ayaleke bokuweli wanu,
english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be 20:26 your servant.

lokele: la oyatolɛmbɛ mbo ayaleke botoli oso wanu, wao koyala nde bɔkɔwa wanu.
english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

lokele: Ko ongoma, Wana wa oto imɔ, atiye ndokuwelomo, kangä okuwela basi, la ndofa liwawi liande angɛnɛ kwa liendoli lia bato wike. Bato ba bɛtuku ba Yeliko
english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

lokele: Asekwäkä iyo nda Yeliko ekuke efi lotut’Inde,
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

lokele: la tɛnɛ, bato bambale ba betuku bayali se nda ɔngɔ wa mboka; okäk’iyo mbo ende Yesu oyatoeta, iyo loamama mbo— Ngɛnɛ, Wana wa Dawidi okelak’iso ngandi.
english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

lokele: Bato ba ekuke loim’iyo mbo bayaleke tau, kongo ko iyo loamamaka ngo likama mbo— Ngɛnɛ, Wana wa Dawidi, okelak’iso ngandi.
english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

lokele: Yesu losikama, Inde lot’iyo lioi, Inde mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nde mbo ikeelek’ino iye?
english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

lokele: Iyo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, mbo baiso basu baliolomoko.
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu lookel’iyo ngandi, Inde lomata baiso bau, lisasaya iyo lɔɔlɔ liɛni liasi, la iyo lotuta Inde.
english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

lokele: Iyäk’iyo tina la Yelusaleme, la ayäk’iyo nda Betefange nda löngo loa Elaya, limɔ Yesu lotoma baeki bambale oso, Inde loonga lau mbo—
english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, 21:1 to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

lokele: Kɛndɛkɛ nda bokenge ebole oso wanu, kwaamao o’toosha punda ekandomu amamwito la efembeli yande; faikolaka yao limɔ eshaka yao ende’mi.
english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

lokele: Boto eonga lanu, ino koonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ asoeno yao, limɔ atoinola yao lisasaya.
english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

lokele: (Lona losokelomo mbo lioi eliaongäkä bɔtɔndɔli likɔchɔmɔkɔ, mbo—
english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

lokele: Kambesaka boseka wa Siona mbo— Tɛnɛ, Bɔkɔta waɛ asoya end’aɛ La bɔfɔmu, l’ani atalemi nda punda, Ango wana, efembeli ya punda.)
english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.” Zechariah 9:9

lokele: Baeki lɔkɛ, iyo lokela kwa akambesäkä Yesu ekambes’iyo,
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

lokele: iyo loesha punda la efembeli, iyo lotalia bisinda yau nda bɔkɔngɔ wa yao, lamao Yesu loyala se nda yao.
english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

lokele: Bato wike ba ekuke lofalola bisinda yau se nda mboka, basi lotenaka bafifa ba tosandu nda bilanga la iyo lota bao imɔ nda mboka.
english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

lokele: La bikuke ebietelaka oso l’ebatutaka mbisa, iyo lɔwɛlɛ lielo mbo— Hosana, ende Wana wa Dawidi, Limɛngɔ end’Inde oyasoya nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ, Hosana nda elela ya tala.
english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna 21:9 to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!” Psalms 118:26

lokele: Ɔtɔkɔ’Inde nda Yelusaleme, bato batotina loilima loasɔ loande, iyo mbo— ¿Oyo ende ndai?
english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

lokele: limɔ bikuke mbo— Oyo ende Yesu, Bɔtɔndɔli wa Nasaleta ya Ngalilai. Lotaneso loa balɛlɛ ba Tempelo
english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, la Inde lokusola iyo batotina ebatoungesa la ebatosomba omao nda Ndakɔ, Inde loukokola baonga ba bafetekwani ba bieto la kangala ya ebaungesäkä bikuku,
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Losɔnɔmu nda lokasa mbo Ndakɔ yami etotangomo ndakɔ ya lisomboli, nde ino nd’asokela la yao, ko lisɛkɔ lia eba biya.
english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ Isaiah 56:7 but you have made it a den of robbers!” Jeremiah 7:11

lokele: Limɔ bato ba betuku l’eba bikoti loya end’Inde omao nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, la Inde losäses’iyo.
english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

lokele: Nde, ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ kanga ebieti la batikasa tolombo etosokel’Inde la ɛnɛ̈k’imɔ iyo bainɛngɛ basoamama nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu mbo— Hosana ende Wana wa Dawidi, iyo losoma finɛ,
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

lokele: iyo loonga la Yesu mbo— ¿Osooka elotoonga e-bana-ba? Inde loonga lau mbo— Eingo nde; ¿Otitange lise ango limɔi, mbo— Ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya bainɛngɛ la banaoli osɔɔlɔlɔ lisemoli?
english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?” Psalms 8:2

lokele: Limɔ Inde lomach’iyo, Inde losekwa nda Yelusaleme, Inde lɔkɛ nda Betania okaingala omao. Bokumo ebotiäkä la tuma
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

lokele: Ainwäk’Inde la nɔngɔ nda bokenge Inde looka isiye,
english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

lokele: ɛnɛ̈k’Inde bokumo la mboka, Inde lɔkɛ tina la wao nde atiosheke yeka nda wao ko kasa ko kasa, Inde loongela wao mbo— Tuma totiangɔ̈tɔ̈ imɔ ina layalaya.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

lokele: Kwaamao kongo, bokumo lobɛɛkɛlɛ fɛɛ. La ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ baeki ongoma, iyo lomwaala, iyo mbo—? Bokumo bosoumama ɔbɛɛkɛlɛ lisasaya moni?
english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

lokele: Yesu lomutola lau mbo— Isoonga lanu wewe mbo eyambo boyala la liimeli, angota fee ani ino kokelaka ani asokelomo nda bokumo la liasi imɔ, boonga nde la e-longo-lo mbo— Ilomoko la umbolomoko tubu nda balia, ambo lokelomoko nde.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

lokele: Bitotina ebitolɔmbɔkɔl’ino nda lisomboli ko la liimeli, bɔɔlɔkɔ nde yao. Lofelo eoka ya isosha sha Yesu
english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

lokele: Aɔtɔ̈kɔ̈ Inde nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, kanga ebieti la biange loosh’Inde ani atoekesa bato, iyo lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Otokelaka njasɔ-bi la sini isosha? ¿Ndai afäk’Aɛ isosha sina?
english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— Itofel’ino imɔ ko lioi limɔi, ino bokambesa’mi, Imi imɔ kokambes’ino isosha esitokela lami njasɔ-bi;
english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

lokele: ¿Lilufi lia Yoane losekwa to nd’anima, kwa nda Use, kwa ende bato? Iyo angɛnɛ lotafelanäka, mbo— Eyambo toonga mbo liaka lia Use, limɔ Inde koonga lasu mbo ¿Eokao, monito otiaimeläkä inde?
english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

lokele: Nde toonga mbo— Elia bato… tosowänga ekuke ya bato eoka batotina basotanga mbo Yoane aaka bɔtɔndɔli.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

lokele: Iyo lomutoela Yesu mbo— Totilüwe. Limɔ Inde loonga lau mbo— La Imi imɔ angokambes’ino isosha esitokela’mi la njasɔ-bi. Wana oyakalanganäkä
english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

lokele: ¿Nde, ino oenyeli moni? Boto ayaläkä la bana atolome bambale, inde lɔkɛ ende ewa oso, inde mbo— Wana, takɛndɛkɛ louse okakela likuwa nda elanga yami ya tuma.
english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

lokele: Inde mbo— Itikulie; kongo ko mbisa inde lokalangana, inde lɔkɛ.
english: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

lokele: Sango lɔkɛ ende ew’ambale, inde loonga imɔ ko ongoma; wana lomutola mbo— Eingo ko Fafa.
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

lokele: Nde atikɛ. ¿Ndai wau ambale akeli lisangi lia sango? Iyo mbo— Ewa oso. Yesu loonga lau mbo— Isoonga lanu wewe, mbo basombesi la batomali ba olëfë batɔtɔkɔ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu oso wanu.
english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

lokele: Eokao Yoane loya oyɛnɛs’ino mboka ya liengani, nde ino otiimelek’inde; kongo ko basombesi la batomali ba olëfë loimel’inde la kwa ɛnɛk’ino ongoma, otiangokalanganaka mbo wimelek’inde. Bombila wa Balɔi babe
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

lokele: Okaka bombila wasi. Yaaka nde oto ɔmɔi, wange wa okenge, oyalɔɔ̈kɔ̈ elanga ya tuma. Inde lolingela yao la likula, inde lofuwa liyöndo liotwangela tuma, inde loemesa ndakɔ ya betingani, inde lomachela balɔi elanga, limɔ inde lɔkɛ yese yasi.
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

lokele: Ayäkä mbile ya eula ya tuma, inde lotoma bɛkɔwa yande ende balɔi mbo baɔsɛkɛ tuma;
english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

lokele: lamao balɔi loundesa bɛkɔwa, iyo lokuchak’ɔmɔi, iyo loola wasi, iyo lokushela wasi batälɛ.
english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

lokele: Lamao inde lotoma bɛkɔwa yasi wike, wolongela eba oso, la iyo lokeela iyo ana ko ongoma.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

lokele: Liili, inde lotoma wana wande angɛnɛ end’iyo, inde mbo— Batolitesa nde wana wami.
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

lokele: Kongo ko ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ balɔi wɛnɛ wana, iyo loongana mbo— Oyo ende bosangesi wa botiko, yauku to, toolek’inde, limɔ iso kɔɔlɔ botiko wande.
english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

lokele: Iyo loundes’inde, iyo loumbol’inde lousa loa elanga, iyo lool’inde.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

lokele: ¿Eokao, akayeke ngɛnɛ wa elanga, ekeelaka balɔi ana iye to?
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Atosɛɛsɛlɛsɛkɛ bato bana babe la liwa libe, emachaka elanga ende balɔi basi ebatofaef’inde tuma nda eula.
english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Otitange lise ango limɔi nda lokasa (loa Mungu) mbo— Litalɛ lina elisofeka baswi, Liao lisoswomo nda botö wa ndakɔ; Loasɔ-lo losoya ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ; La nda baiso basu lole losemolomo?
english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’? Psalms 118:22-23

lokele: Eokao Imi isoonga lanu mbo— Bɔkɔta wa Mungu bosokolomoko end’ino, la bofaefomoko tukela ebatoesha tuma twa wao.
english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

lokele: Boto oyatokwa likulya nda litalɛ-li, inde kounya; kongo ko litalɛ-li likwa ende boto, liao komiak’inde kwa fututi.
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

lokele: Okäka kanga ebieti la BaFalusi bembila-bi ya Yesu, iyo loleembela mbo asoongel’iyo angɛnɛ.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

lokele: Nde akotäk’iyo ndoundes’Inde, iyo lowänga bato ba ekuke, eoka iyo lotang’Inde mbo bɔtɔndɔli.
english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

lokele: Yesu loongana lau liasi ko la bembila, mbo—
english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

lokele: Bɔkɔta wa Use bole kwa bɔkɔta wa yese oyakenjäka elambɔ ya lisɔngi lia wana wande,
english: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

lokele: inde lɔkɛsɛ bɛkɔwa yande ɔkɔsɔ ebatomökö lioi nda elambɔ ya lisɔngi; nde iyo lofeka ndoya.
english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

lokele: Limɔ inde lotoma bɛkɔwa yasi, inde mbo— Kambesaka ebatomökö lioi mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, bieka ya elambɔ bisoela, mbolo yami la bana ba mbolo ya bonuku bisoolomo, bitotina bisoengana, yauku nda elambɔ ya lisɔngi.
english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

lokele: Nde iyo lolemola loasɔ, iyo lɔkɛndɛ, ɔmɔi nda elanga yande, ɔmɔi nda bokalala wande;
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

lokele: ebamɔi loundesa bɛkɔwa, iyo lokeelak’iyo sɔni, iyo lool’iyo.
english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

lokele: Okäkä bɔkɔta ongoma, inde losoma la bolengi, inde lotomaka basilikani bande okasɛɛsɛlɛsɛ baoli ba bato bana, iyo lofechaka okenge wau la ösä.
english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

lokele: Limɔ inde loonga la bɛkɔwa yande mbo— Elambɔ ya lisɔngi esotonjomo, nde ebatomökö lioi batiengane,
english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

lokele: eokao kɛndɛkɛ to nda bau ba balabala la eshaka ono nda elambɔ bato ebakoshek’ino omao.
english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

lokele: Bɛkɔwa ina lɔkɛ nda balabala; iyo losɔngɔmɛsɛ batotina eboshak’iyo, bato babe l’ebalau lisanga, ongoma elambɔ lotumaka l’ato.
english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

lokele: Nde aɔtɔ̈kɔ̈ bɔkɔta otichak’iyo ebatola bieka, inde lɔɛnɛ boto omao oyatiwate esinda yoengana elambɔ ya lisɔngɔni.
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

lokele: Bɔkɔta loonga lande mbo— ¿Wina, osɔɔtɔ ono ani otiwate esinda ya elambɔ ya lisɔngi moni? Nde boto angomutola ango lioi.
english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

lokele: Limɔ bɔkɔta loonga la basali mbo— Kandak’inde la besamba la bakolo, umbolak’inde lousa nda bounduundu wa mbi; omao bitookana la bileli la ngɛlɛtɛ ya bainyo.
english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

lokele: Eoka bato wike nd’asotomo lioi, nde ko bamyo kongo basoaomo. Bɔsɔmbi wa Kaisala
english: For many are called, but few chosen.”

lokele: Lamao BaFalusi lɔkɛ okɔtɔ ikumbɛ sha loasɔ lokwes’Inde nda liekesi liande.
english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

lokele: Iyo lotoma baeki bau amamwito l’eba Helodi ende Yesu, iyo mbo— Boekesi, tosolüwa mbo wende wewe, la mbo otoekekesa mboka ya Mungu la wewe, la mbo oitowänga oto la oitotichaka bɔmbɔ wa bato;
english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

lokele: Kambesaka to iso kwa atoenyel’Aɛ; ¿Mbo losoengana ofaefa Kaisala bɔsɔmbi, kwa angofa?
english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

lokele: Kongo ko Yesu lolembeela bobe wau, Inde mbo— ¿Otokotela’mi eoka iye, ino balimbaki?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

lokele: Tambaka’mi bieto yokamba bɔsɔmbi. Iyo loeshel’Inde lofalanga.
english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Bolendela-bo la lisɔni-li bile ya ndai?
english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

lokele: Iyo mbo— Ya Kaisala. Lamao Inde loonga lau mbo— Inolaka to ende Kaisala ko eya Kaisala la inolaka ende Mungu ko eya Mungu.
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

lokele: Okäkä bato ongoma, iyo lomwaala, iyo lomach’Inde, iyo lɔkɛ eyau. Litɛmwi nda Liwa
english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

lokele: La lise-ao BaSadoke bamɔi loya ende Inde, ebaimeläkä mbo angwɛnɛ imɔ litɛmwi nda liwa; iyo lofela Yesu mbo—
english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

lokele: Boekesi, Mose mbo boto ewa, angoota wana, limɔ etungani yande atosɔngɔ lotika loa boloo mbo aoteleke boloo wana.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring 22:24 for his brother.’

lokele: Toka, eyasu tole la bana batolome bosambale ba sango ɔmɔi; boloo losɔngɔ wali la inde lowa, nde atimache wana, etungani yande losangola wali.
english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

lokele: Ewa ambale ko ongoma; imɔ ko ewa asatɔ, ko ewa osambale, batotina ko ongoma.
english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

lokele: Mbisa, otomali imɔ lowa liili.
english: After them all, the woman died.

lokele: Eokao nda litɛmwi nda liwa, otomali atoyala wali wa ndai wau osambale, eoka iyo batotina basɔngɔ̈kɔ̈ ko inde.
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Osotwanelo, eoka otilüwe Kasa ya Mungu la bofoka wande imɔ.
english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

lokele: Eoka nda litɛmwi nda liwa, batolome angosɔngɔ, la batomali angosɔngɔmɔ imɔ, nde beyalaka kwa bakitomo nda use.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

lokele: Nde loasɔ loa litɛmwi lia ebawi, okatangi kɔni eloaongäkä Mungu lanu, mbo—
english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

lokele: Imi yende Mungu wa Abalayama, Mungu wa Isaka, Mungu wa Yakobo, otitange ongoma? Mungu ati Mungu wa ebawi, kangä wa ebale la liwawi.
english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? Exodus 3:6 God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

lokele: Okäkä eba bikuke ongoma iyo lomwaala liekesi liande. Bikela Bieti
english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

lokele: Nde okäkä BaFalusi mbo Yesu akandiki bɛnɔkɔ ya BaSadoke, iyo losɔngɔmɔ nda loasɔ-lo,
english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

lokele: la ɔmɔi wau ako bosanokoli wa Bikela lofel’Inde lofelo lokotel’Inde, inde mbo—
english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

lokele: ¿Boekesi, nda Bikela, eni ekela eyeti fafo?
english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Samaka Bɔkɔta Mungu waɛ la botema bototina, la bolimo waɛ bototina, la baenyeli baɛ batotina.
english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ Deuteronomy 6:5

lokele: Eyele ekela ya oso la eyeti fafo,
english: This is the first and great commandment.

lokele: la eya imbale eyengani la yao eko mbo— Samaka boyalani laɛ kwa ani otosama aɛ angɛnɛ.
english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ Leviticus 19:18

lokele: Bikela bitotina la Baoi ba Batɔndɔli basoomana la bikelabi bimbale.
english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

lokele: Asɔngɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ BaFalusi ongoma, Yesu lofel’imɔ ko iyo lofelo, mbo—
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

lokele: ¿Otoenyela iye loasɔ loa Masiya, mbo ende wana wa ndai? Iyo mbo— Wana wa Dawidi.
english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Eya ongoma, monito Dawidi kotang’Inde mbo Ngɛnɛ ko la Bolimo, ani Dawidi mbo—
english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga la Ngɛnɛ wami mbo— Yalaka se nda bosamba wami wa olome, Kond’atɔsɛlɛ’mi baiyani baɛ ose ya batindi baɛ?
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’? Psalms 110:1

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo Dawidi atangäk’Inde mbo Ngɛnɛ, Ale to wana wande imɔ la moni?
english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

lokele: Angwɛnɛ boto wokɔkɔlɔ ndomutoel’Inde lioi ango limɔi, la mbisa ya lise-ao, oto angɔmɔi angotendela imɔ ofela Inde felo.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

lokele: Lamao Yesu loonga la eba bikuke la baeki bande,
english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

lokele: Inde mbo— Batikasa la BaFalusi basoyala se nda kɛ̈ka ya Mose;
english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

lokele: eokao kelakaka la litesaka bitotina ebitoong’iyo eonga lanu, kongo ko, okelëke kwa atokel’iyo, eoka batoonga nde baitokela.
english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

lokele: Batokandaka bekuku ya belito bewaü wotolaka, limɔ batotalia yao nda batotoko ba bato ani iyo angɛnɛ angolɛmbɛ okɛndɛsɛ yao ango la isangakala shau.
english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

lokele: Nde bekeeli yau bitotina bile ko yɔɛnɛlɛ nda baiso ba bato kongo; batofalokola biuku ya kasa (ebitol’iyo nda bindo), batolongamesa basimbɛlɛ ba bisinda yau,
english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries 23:5 broad and enlarge the fringes 23:5 of their garments,

lokele: batolola bilela ya oso nda bilambɔ la kangala ya betoli oso nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ,
english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

lokele: la mbo balamokolomoko nda baöngo la ndotangomoko mbo Labi (Boekesi).
english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ 23:7 by men.

lokele: Nde ino angotangomo Labi eoka wende ko la Boekesi ɔmɔi la ino yaatotina wende beoto.
english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

lokele: Otangëke boto wa wenda mbo sango, eoka ɔmwito kongo nd’ayali Sango ako Inde oyayali nda Use.
english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

lokele: Otangomöko mbo Botoli-oso, eoka ko ɔmwito kongo nd’ayali Botoli-oso wanu, ako Masiya.
english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

lokele: Boto wanu oyalongeli, eyelaka bosali wanu,
english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

lokele: la oyatotaliaka inde angɛnɛ, ɛɔndwɛsɔmɔkɔ se hondwa, la oyatɔɔndwa se inde angɛnɛ, etaliomoko tala. Baɛngɔ bawau ende BaFalusi
english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino Batikasa la BaFalusi, balimbaki eoka ino nd’atolinjaka biome ya Bɔkɔta wa Use oso wa bato; ino angɛnɛ angɔɔtɔ la ino nd’atokufesa ebakɔɔtɔ ina.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino Batikasa la BaFalusi, balimbaki eoka ino otolekaka wenda la balia ndokɔsɔ ɔmɔi oyatokinjwa kwa atoimel’ino angɛnɛ, limɔ akayalek’inde ewa, ino kokindol’inde wana wa Ngehena woeta boyaeli obe wanu angɛnɛ ko baeta bambale.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna 23:15 as yourselves.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino Betoli-oso eba betuku. Ino nd’atoonga mbo— Boto etinya ekanɔ ko la Ndakɔ ya Mungu, loti loasɔ; nde etinya ekanɔ ko la bieto ebile nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, ambo ale la bolima wokamba.
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

lokele: Ino ba ebebe la etuku; ¿Eni to nd’aeti, kwa bieto, kwa Ndakɔ ya Mungu eyetosɛlɛ bieto la botanu?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

lokele: Liasi, ino mbo— Boto etinya ekanɔ ko la etambelo ya lifaefi, ambo loti to loasɔ; nde boto etinya ekanɔ ko la lifaefi angɛnɛ, sakolo ko atokɔcha ekanɔ.
english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

lokele: Ino b’etuku; ¿Eni to nd’aeti, kwa lifaefi, kwa etambelo eyetücha lifaefi?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

lokele: Boto oyasotinya ekanɔ la etambelo, asotinya yao ngo la etambelo la imɔ nda bieka ebiyali likolo lia yao lisanga;
english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

lokele: la oyatatinya ekanɔ la Ndakɔ ya Mungu, atotinya yao ngo ko la Ndakɔ la imɔ ko la Inde oyayali nda yao;
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living 23:21 in it.

lokele: oyatotinya ekanɔ ko la Use, atotinya ekanɔ ngo ko la kɛka ya Mungu, imɔ ko la Inde oyayali se nda yao lisanga.
english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino Batikasa la BaFalusi bako balimbaki, eoka ino kokusolaka likaɔ lia botüku wa liu nda kasakasa ya lɔɛtɛ, kongo ko osounga ndola yoeta la litina biko liengani, la booto, la liimeli; lole lanu ndokelaka, ani ebimɔi imɔ biti yoomelomoko.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, 23:23 and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

lokele: Ino betoli-oso ya etuku, otokangola balia ndosokola ikungu sikɛkɛ, nde botomɛlɛ ngamela mɛu.
english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino Batikasa la BaFalusi ba ko balimbaki, eoka ino kotanekesa lousa loa kɔpɔ la lɔfɛfɛ, nde nd’atiteni esotumaka la yeka ya wiya la bɔlɛfɛ.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness. 23:25

lokele: Aɛ BoFalusi wa botuku, tatanesaka atiteni ya kɔpɔ la lɔfɛfɛ limɔ lousa kotana lisanga.
english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

lokele: Aeko wale end’ino Batikasa la BaFalusi, eoka ino nd’atokwelomo la losai elososiyomoko la fɛmbɛ lousa; ani lousa losoɛnɛlɛ kwa tɔfɔfɔ, nde nd’atiteni bisotumaka la tokwa twa belyo la bɛwɛwɛ ya bɔlɛlɔ.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

lokele: Ino ko ongoma, lousa otoɛnɛlɛ bato ba liengani nde atiteni osobeba la bolimbakeli la batwanelo.
english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

lokele: Aeko wake end’ino Batikasa la BaFalusi, eoka otoswa sai ya batɔndɔli ba oso la otokomya kito y’ebaengani,
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

lokele: nde koonga mbo— Twaäkä nda fɛtɔ ya bangau basu, ani totiasanganäkä lau ndosondola bakila ba batɔndɔli.
english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

lokele: Ko ongoma osoaola mbo wende bana ba bato ebaoläkä batɔndɔli.
english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

lokele: Eokao, ɔlɔlɔkɔ to ikweelo sha bangau banu.
english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

lokele: Ino wende njɔ, wende bana ba manga; ¿otolɔmwaka mbo otafomo se la okɛsɔmɔ nda Ngehena ya bösä?
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna? 23:33

lokele: Tɛnɛngɔ, ko l’eokao Imi nd’atotomaka end’ino, la batɔndɔli la eba wɛlï la batikasa, kongo ko ino boolaka nde bamɔi, bowachaka bamɔi nda liyeka, bokuchaka bamɔi fimbo nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ yanu, boengaka bamɔi ko nda okenge la okenge,
english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

lokele: ko mbo bakila ba batotina-ba ebawäkä l’angwɛnɛ litwanelo, bao bakungameke ko end’ino, bako bakila ba Abɛlɛ, konda bakila ba Sekalaya, wana wa Balakaya-oyaoläkä ino ool’inde tina la Euchelo la Etambelo ya lifaefi nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu—
english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

lokele: Isoonga lanu wewe mbo— Bitotina-bi bilaomanaka la nyongo ya efɛtɔ-ye y’ato.
english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

lokele: Aeko Yelusaleme; Yelusaleme ona oyaoläka batɔndɔli, oyakushakäkä batalɛ boola ebatomomökö end’ino. Aina mbile eyokäkä’mi yɛmɛ yosɔnjak’ino bana ba Yelusaleme kwa atokukya kɔkɔ bana bande ose ya bafafu bande, kongo ko ino angɔlɛmbɛ.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

lokele: Tɛnɛngo, bokenge waɛ bosomachana ko isimo,
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

lokele: isoonga lanu wewe mbo otiangɔɛnɛ’mi imɔ konda eyekaongeke lanu mbo— Limɛngɔ liyeke lande oyatoya nde lina lia Ngɛnɛ.
english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’” Psalms 118:26

lokele: Yesu lokuswa nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu limɔ a kɛndɛk’Inde, baeki bande loyaɛnɛs’Inde bosweli wa Ndakɔ,
english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

lokele: nde Yesu loonga lau mbo— ¿Osɔɛnɛ to bitotina-bi? Isoonga lanu wewe mbo angwɛnɛ litalɛ ango limɔi lilamachomoko likolo lia liasi nde batotina belaukolomoko.
english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

lokele: Ayaläk’Inde se nda löngo loa Elaya baeki bayäkä end’Inde wisakumbo, iyo mbo— Kambesaka to iso mbile eyekayeke njasɔ-bi la eni ndembe yolembeela mbo osamboya la ya basilelo ba wenda-bo?
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

lokele: Yesu lomutoel’iyo mbo— Lambaka la wɛlï mbo boto atalimb’ino,
english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

lokele: eoka wike batoya nda lina liami ani batoonga mbo— Imi yende Masiya la batoengolaka basi wike.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

lokele: Bolaokaka mboli ya bita la iwaesa sha bita; owangëke, eoka bilayaka nde, kongo ko losilo lokayi kɔni.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

lokele: Yese la yese bitowesana, la bɔkɔta la bɔkɔta batowesana, fondo la lotukeso loa nyɛlɛ bilayaka la elela la elela.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

lokele: Nde bitotina-bi bile ko liakoli lia ielo.
english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

lokele: Lamao bɛkɛsɛkɛ ino ende ebatokuchak’ino la batool’ino la boiyanomoko l’eoka ya lina liami nda tukela bitotina.
english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

lokele: Wike bekwaka se, la boto atowamba wina lande, la beiyanaka
english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

lokele: la batɔndɔli ba nanga wike beyaka nde, limɔ iyo belimbaka basi wike.
english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

lokele: Limɔ eoka mbo litefoli litokonda finɛ, basi wike batotɛkwa, samɔ ya beoto bitosaa;
english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

lokele: kongo ko oyatokɔkɔmɔ ko nda liko, ambo inde elauwesomoko.
english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

lokele: Mboli Ilau-bi bilanangolomoko nda wenda bototina kwa boekï wotomo ende bato ba tukela bitotina. Lamao basilelo belayaka.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

lokele: Eokao, akɛnɛk’ino wɛnɛ bɔlɛlɔ wa lioma, eliaongomökö la Danyɛlɛ ewa bɔtɔndɔli, bosoyala nda Elela eyuchomo (oyatotanga aluweke litina)
english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, Daniel 9:27 which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

lokele: kwaamao eba Yudea bakweke mangu konda föngo.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

lokele: Boto eyala olikolo lia ndakɔ yande, angotasulwaka se okaluke biengo nda ndakɔ;
english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

lokele: boto eyala nda elanga angoinywa imɔ okenge okɔsɔ esinda yande.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

lokele: Aeko wale ende batomali ba lieme la ebatomwesa bana baɛlɛ nda bacho ana.
english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

lokele: Sombolaka mbo botili ebokakwek’ino botaya nda bɔtɔkɔ kwa nda bɔfɛfyɔ, kwa la lise lia yenga,
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

lokele: eoka nda bacho ana bifembi belayaka kwa ebitiayäkä oso, ango ko nda baakoelo ba wenda konda kwani la botilayek’imɔ ongoma liasi.
english: for then there will be great suffering, 24:21 such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

lokele: Aenaka mbo bacho bana betungesomoko, ani angwɛnɛ angɔmwito angouwa, kongo ko bacho bana belatungesomoko ko l’eoka ya ebaaomökö.
english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

lokele: Nda mbile ena eyambo boto eonga lanu mbo— Tɛnɛ Masiya eyamaya; Tɛnɛ ale onamona, wimelëke,
english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

lokele: Eoka BaMasiya ba nanga la bɛtɔndɔli ba nanga beyaka nde la tokesa la ndembe ya isosha mbo bekɔkɔlɔ ndolimbaka ango ebasoaaomo angɛnɛ.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

lokele: Tɛnɛngɔ, isotäkambes’ino loao oso.
english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

lokele: Eokao beonga lanu mbo— Tɛnɛ, ale nda liɔmbɛlɛ, otakuswëke okɛnɛ, beonga mbo— Tɛnɛ, ale nda kuku ya ndakɔ, wimelëke.
english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

lokele: Eoka kwa atokuswa ibalibali fangi ya ɛsɔswɛlɔ ya bonyanya okɛnɛlɛ fangi ya baɔndwɛlɔ, bayelo ba Wana wa Boto beyalaka ko ongoma.
english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

lokele: Eoka olo akayaleke bolyo, ambo toyoiyoli kosɔngɔmɔ ngo ko omao.
english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures 24:28 gather together.

lokele: Lisasaya mbisa ya bifembi ya bacho bana, liso lia use litotufatufa la tengai angoanyemaka imɔ, la tolonge totokwaka se la befoka ya use betotukatuka.
english: “But immediately after the suffering 24:29 of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken; Isaiah 13:10

lokele: Limɔ ndembe ya Wana wa Boto elaɛnɛlɛkɛ nda use, la tukela bitotina ya wenda belalelaka ndeli, limɔ belɛnɛkɛ Wana wa Boto atoya nda bafita ba use la bofoka la bɔfɛkɔ finɛ.
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

lokele: Limɔ atotoma bakitomo bande ebatooma ifonge sifi la batosɔnjak’iyo ebasoaaomo l’olo l’olo fangi bitotina konda liko lia use konda liko elimɔi lia use.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

lokele: Lüwaka loasɔ elosokwelomo la bokumo; atofɛtɛ wao la atɔ̈tɛkɛ batombɔ ba wao, ongoma otolüwa mbo eula esamboya.
english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

lokele: Ongoma akɛnɛkɛ ino wɛnɛ njasɔ-bi bitotina, lüwaka mbo Inde asoya tina, ango nda bome.
english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe mbo— E-fɛtɔ-ye eitosila oso ani e-njasɔ-bi bitotina bikayi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation 24:34 will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

lokele: Use la se bilawanjwaka bao, kongo ko baoi bami batilawanjweke imɔ.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

lokele: Nde angwɛnɛ oto angɔmwito nd’alüwi lise lina, kwa saa ena, bakitomo angolüwa, Wana angolüwa, sakolo ko Sango Inde nd’alüwi.
english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, 24:36 but my Father only.

lokele: Nde kwa ayaläkä bato nda mbile ya Noa, belayalaka nda bayelo ba Wana wa Boto.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

lokele: Eoka nda bacho oso wa fela efi, bato balakäkä bieka la bamwäkä, basɔngɔ̈kɔ̈ la basɔngɛsɔmɔ̈kɔ̈, konda lise eliaɔtɔkɔ Noa nda ndakɔ ya watɔ,
english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

lokele: la batialüwäkä ani ayäkä fela efi loyaɔmbes’iyo yaatotina hɔmbɛ; bayelo ba Wana wa Boto belayalaka ko ongoma.
english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

lokele: Lamao batolome bambale beyala nda elanga, ɔmɔi kosokolomo, ɔmɔi komachana.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

lokele: Batomali bambale beunda bosöngö wa lokulu lotwanga, ɔmɔi kosokolomo, oyo ɔmɔi komachana.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

lokele: Eokao lambaka la wɛlï, oitolüwa bocho ebokayeke la Ngɛnɛ wanu.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

lokele: Nde lüwaka mbo eya ngo mbo ngɛnɛ wa ndakɔ alüwäkä oso ko la mbile eyekayeke ewa wiya ani alambäkä la wɛlï l’ani atiamachäkä mbo ndakɔ yande efindolomoko la wiya.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

lokele: Eokao enganaka la yose, eoka Wana wa Boto eyaka nda mbile eyeitoenyela lanu.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

lokele: Ndai to atoyala bɔkɔwa wa likɔchi la wa wɛli ani ngɛnɛ wande oyasotalia inde bonyafala wa bato bande mbo akaelek’iyo bieka yau la lisho lioengana?
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

lokele: Limɛngɔ la olau ende bɔkɔwa ona ani ngɛnɛ wande atoyaosh’inde nda likuwa.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe mbo— Atotalia boto ona bonyafala wa yeka yande bitotina.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

lokele: Nde eya mbo bɔkɔwa ona obe, eonga nda botema mbo— Ngɛnɛ wami asoumwaka oya;
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

lokele: lamao inde koakola oomaka bɛkɔwa ebamɔi, la ndolaka la ndowa bänä amamwito la basi ebatolɛwa bänä;
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

lokele: limɔ ngɛnɛ wa bɔkɔwa ona eyaka nde la bocho ebotïlüwe inde, ebotiwɛlɛ inde ngɛnɛ baiso,
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

lokele: atomumol’inde la fimbo la atosɛl’inde amamwito la ebalimbaki olo atookana bileli la ngɛlɛtɛ ya bainyo.
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

lokele: Lamao, Bɔkɔta wa Use botokwelomo la baseka liu ebaɔsɔ̈kɔ̈ paka yau, okatowana la botolome ɔmɔi oyaɛkɛ okɔsɔ bowai nda lisɔngɔni.
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

lokele: Bɔɔmwi ba baseka baaka bibebe, la bɔɔmwi ba wɛlï;
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

lokele: eoka aɔsɔ̈kɔ̈ ebibebe paka yau, batiɔsɛ baita amamwito;
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

lokele: kongo ko eba wɛlï, iyo lotola baita basi nda kamaisonga amamwito la paka yau.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

lokele: Nde ewa lisɔngi loumwaka oya, eokao iyo yaatotina lowa bolengelenge la iyo loingala ilɔ.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

lokele: Nde la ɛsɔkɔ ya ocho lioi liaokomökö mbo— Itɔkɔ, Ewa lisɔngi-yo; kuswaka okatowana lande.
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

lokele: Lamao baseka batotina ana loemakala, iyo loanekesa paka yau la wɛlï,
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps. 25:7

lokele: Limɔ eba bibebe loonga la eba wɛlï mbo— Faef’iso sumbu baita bamɔi banu eoka paka yasu bisotiakama.
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

lokele: Nde eba wɛlï mbo— Bataengana lasu lanu imɔ; takɛndɛkɛ to ende baungekesi ba baita okasomba ebanu angɛnɛ.
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

lokele: Aɛk’iyo okasomba, ewa lisɔngi loya; limɔ baseka ebakɔmɔnyi la paka yau, iyo lɔtɔ amamwito lande nda elambɔ ya lisɔngɔni la bome wa ndakɔ lolinjomo.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

lokele: Mbisa, baseka ebamɔi loya imɔ, iyo mbo— Ngɛnɛ, Ngɛnɛ lioelak’iso.
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

lokele: Nde inde lomutola lau mbo— Isoonga lanu wewe mbo itilüwe ino.
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

lokele: Eokao, lambaka la wɛlï, eoka otilüwe kwa bocho kwa saa. Bombila wa bɛkɔwa ya lotimbana la ewa booshaosha
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

lokele: Lole nde kwa boto oyatɔkɛ lɔkɛndɔ esika, inde lota bɛkɔwa yande lioi, inde lofaef’iyo biengo yande.
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

lokele: Inde lofaefa ɔmɔi batanga bɔɔmwi ba bieto, inde lofa wasi batanga bambale, la wasi limwito, ende oto la oto inde lofa yao yoengana la wɛlï wande, limɔ inde lɔkɛ lɔkɛndɔ.
english: To one he gave five talents, 25:15 to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

lokele: Kwaamao boto oyaɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ batanga bɔɔmwi, inde lɔkɛ okatimbesa bokalala wande la bao, inde lɔɔlɔ botalia wa bɔɔmwi basi.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

lokele: Ko ongoma imɔ ewa ambale lɔɔlɔ basi bambale.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

lokele: Kongo ko oyaɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ litanga limɔi, inde lɔkɛ okafuwa nda nyɛlɛ, inde loisa bieto ya ngɛnɛ wande omao.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

lokele: Mbisa ya mbile yumwa, ngɛnɛ wa bɛkɔwa ana loinywa; akomiäk’inde lau belima,
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

lokele: limɔ oyaɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ bɔɔmwi loyaesha basi bɔɔmwi imɔ, inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, wafaefäkä’mi batanga bɔɔmwi, tɛnɛ, isɔɔlɛsɛ basi bɔɔmwi.
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wande loonga lande mbo— Bolau, wende bɔkɔwa olau wolendelomo, osokɔcha yao bimyɔ, isofaef’aɛ isosha likolo lia wike, ɔtɔkɔ limɛngɔ lia ngɛnɛ waɛ.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

lokele: Limɔ oyaɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ ambale loya, inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, wafaefäkä’mi batanga bambale, tɛnɛ isɔɔlɛsɛ basi bambale.
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wande loonga lande mbo— Bolau, wende bɔkɔwa olau wolendelomo, osokɔcha yao bimyɔ, isofaef’aɛ isosha likolo lia wike, ɔtɔkɔ limɛngɔ lia ngɛnɛ waɛ.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

lokele: Limɔ oyaɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ ko litanga limɔi loya, inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ, yalüwäk’aɛ mbo wende boto owaü, ototwaka yao ebitilɔɛk’aɛ, otoinaka yao ebitifɛf’aɛ;
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

lokele: yawangäkä la yaɛ̈kɛ̈ okaisa bieto yaɛ nda nyɛlɛ. Tɛnɛ, ɔsɔkɔ eyaɛ angɛnɛ.
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

lokele: Nde ngɛnɛ wande lomutoel’inde mbo— Bɔkɔwa obe wa booshaosha, ¿walüwäkä to mbo itotwaka yao ebitilɔɛkɛ’mi, la mbo itoinaka yao ebitifɛfɛ’mi?
english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

lokele: Eokao loenganiki laɛ ofa bieto yami ende ebatoisa yao la bɔsɛɛli, mbo akainyweke’mi, yaɔlɔ eyami bieto la bɔsɛɛli lisanga.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

lokele: Eokao, ɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ litanga liami end’inde la faefaka ewa batanga liu.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

lokele: Eoka, oyasɔɔlɔ, efomoko nde yasi la atoyala la lilya, nde oyati la yeka, ambo eyele lande, yao kɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔ end’inde.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

lokele: Nde umbolaka e-bɔkɔwa w’ɛkwɛlɛ lousa nda lilima, olo atookana bileli la ngɛlɛtɛ ya bainyo. Ebale la Booto la ebati la Booto
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

lokele: Nde elayalaka Wana wa Boto nda tala yande amamwito la bakitomo batotina, eyalaka se nda kɛka ya tala yande;
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

lokele: Bato ba wenda bototina belasɔngɔmɔkɔ oso wa bɔmbɔ wande,
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

lokele: limɔ Inde kosɛnyanɛsɛ bato shɛi, kwa atokela botingani wa bɛkɔkɔ la mbuli, inde kosɛlɛ bɛkɔkɔ nda bosamba wande wa olome nde mbuli nda ewa wali.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

lokele: Limɔ Bɔkɔta eongaka nde l’eba bosamba wande wa olome, mbo— Yauku, ino ba lɔkɛmɔ loa Sango wami, sangolaka bɔkɔta ewakomyelomoko ino konda bakelelo ba wenda,
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

lokele: eoka yayaläkä la isiyɛ la wafäkä Imi bieka; yokäkä yɛmɛ ya balia, la wamwesäkä’mi; yayaläkä bɔɛnda la waɔtɛsɛ̈k’mi nda ndakɔ;
english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

lokele: yayaläkä wase, la wawatesäkä’mi bisinda; yayaläkä la loo la wayäkä fɛtɛti ende’mi; yakandomökö bɔnyɔlɔlɔ la wayäkä ende’mi.
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

lokele: Lamao eba liengani bemutoelaka Inde mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, twɛnɛ̈k’Aɛ la isiyɛ l’eni to mbile, ani iso lof’Aɛ bieka? Ango la yɛmɛ ya balia, nde kof’Aɛ yomwa?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

lokele: ¿Twɛnɛ̈k’Aɛ bɔɛnda, nde kɔɔtɛsɛk’Aɛ ndakɔ, ango wase, nde twawates’Aɛ?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

lokele: ¿Eni mbile twɛnɛ̈k’Aɛ la loo, kwa nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, nde koya fɛtɛti end’Aɛ?
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

lokele: Limɔ Bɔkɔta emutoelak’iyo mbo— Isoonga lanu wewe mbo ko l’eoka mbo wakeläkä ongoma ende ɔmɔi wa beoto yami oyakɛli se, ambo shooto kongo, wakeeläkä’mi ongoma.
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, 25:40 you did it to me.’

lokele: Lamao eongäkä lau eba bosamba wa wali imɔ mbo— Sokwaka ende’mi, ino ebasendomu bieo, konda bösä wa likati ebosokomyelomo Satana la bakitomo bande;
english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

lokele: eoka yayaläkä la isiyɛ, nde otiafäkä’mi yeka, yokäkä yɛmɛ yomwa, nde otiafäkä’mi yomwa;
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

lokele: yayaläkä bɔɛnda, nde otiaɔtɛsɛ̈kɛ̈’mi ndakɔ, yayaläkä wase, nde otiawatesäkä’mi bisinda; yayaläkä la loo la nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, nde otiayäkä fɛtɛti ende’mi.
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

lokele: Iyo imɔ bemutoelak’Inde mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, twɛnɛ̈k’Aɛ la isiyɛ, kwa la yɛmɛ yomwa, kwa bɔɛnda, kwa wase, kwa la loo, kwa nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, nde iso angowɛl’Aɛ lisungi liasu?
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

lokele: Lamao Inde elamutoelak’iyo mbo— Itoonga lanu wewe mbo— ko l’eoka mbo otiakeläkä ongoma ende ɔmɔi wa beoto yami oyakɛli se, ambo otiakeeläkä’mi imɔ ongoma.
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

lokele: La iyo ana balakɛndɛkɛ konda likuchaki lia layalaya, kongo ko eba liengani kɔkɛndɛ konda liwawi lia layalaya.
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

lokele: Asiläkä Yesu ndoongana lau ebaoi-ba batotina, limɔ Inde loonga la baeki bande mbo—
english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

lokele: Olüwi nde mbo mbisa ya bacho bambale, Elambɔ ya Lieti etoya la mbo Wana wa Boto ewambomoko mbo aolomoko nda liyeka.
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

lokele: Lamao kanga ebieti, la biange ya bato losɔngɔmɔkɔ nda lɔmbɔ loa kanga eya wange ako Kayafa,
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

lokele: la iyo lotwana kuko mbo baundeseke Yesu ko la shɔngɔlɔ mbo bolek’Inde.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

lokele: Kongo ko iyo loonga mbo— Inga nda lise lia Elambɔ mbo bato batakelaka etondo efi. Yesu nda Betania
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

lokele: Ayaläkä Yesu nda Betania nda ndakɔ ya Simona ewa baɛndi,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

lokele: otomali loya end’Inde la isako sha litalɛ sha baningo ba liɛsɛ ba loketi lofi fafo, la botomali losondola bao nda botö wa Yesu ani ayali Inde nda bieka.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ baeki bande ongoma, iyo loongana la botema wäle, iyo mbo— ¿Koseya baningo-ba eok’iye?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

lokele: Bao beungesomo la loketi lofi fafo, yao kofomo ende eba touwe.
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

lokele: Alüwäkä Yesu lioi-li, Inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Otosomel’inde ako otomali monito? Asokeela’mi likeeli lilau fafo.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

lokele: Wende la eba touwe lanu mbile bitotina, nde oti lami amamwito lanu mbile bitotina.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

lokele: Eoka asondolik’inde baningo nda bindo yami, akeliki nde ani loasɔ loa loombomo loami.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

lokele: Itoonga lanu wewe to, mbo— L’olo l’olo atonangolomo Mboli Ilau nda wenda bototi, elosokela botomali-bo, loao imɔ koongomo kwa loenyelesomo loande. Yudasi
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

lokele: Limɔ ɔmɔi wa eba liu la bambale lina liande liko Yudasi wa Keliote, inde lɔkɛ ende kanga ebieti,
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

lokele: inde loonga mbo— Otokulia ofa’mi iye, eyambo imi nd’atowamb’Inde end’ino? Iyo lokweel’inde bieto yoengana pata kama isatɔ.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

lokele: Konda mbile-ao Yudasi lolukä fofe yowamba Yesu. Elambɔ ya BaYuda
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

lokele: Nda lise lia oso lia Elambɔ ya lituma, baeki loya ende Yesu oyafel’Inde mbo— ¿Olɛmbi mbo tokomyelek’Aɛ Elambɔ ya Lieti mbo oleke yao anima to?
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

lokele: Inde mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ nda okenge ende Asisa, ongaka lande mbo, Boekesi mbo— Mbile yami esamboya, itola Elambɔ ya Lieti nda ndakɔ yaɛ amamwito la baeki bami.
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

lokele: La baeki lokela kwa akambesäkä Yesu iyo la iyo lokomya Elambɔ ya Lieti.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

lokele: Iläkä buse litele, Inde loyala se nda bieka amamwito la baeki liu la bambale.
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

lokele: Aläk’iyo, Yesu mbo— Itoonga lanu wewe mbo ɔmɔi wanu nd’atowamba’mi.
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

lokele: Iyo looka ikɛnɛnɛ sifi la iyo loakola ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi ndoonga lande mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, ende to imi?
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

lokele: Inde lomutola mbo— Inde oyasotaela bosamba amamwito lami nda lɔfɛfɛ, ambo inde-yo nd’atowamba’mi.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

lokele: Wana wa Boto atɔkɛ ndɔkɛ kwa atomökö nda Lokasa eoka yande, kongo ko aeko wale ende oto ona oyatowamba Wana wa Boto. Bolau ende oto-ao ani atiaotomökö angootomo.
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

lokele: Lamao Yudasi oyawambäk’Inde, inde lomutola mbo— ¿Boekesi, ende to imi? Inde mbo— Aɛ nd’asoonga. Elambɔ ya Masiya
english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

lokele: Aläk’iyo, Yesu lɔɔsɔ lituma, Inde lofa kelekëlë, Inde louna liao, Inde lofaefa baeki, Inde mbo— Ɔsɔkɔ, laka liao, lile bindo yami.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for 26:26 it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

lokele: Lamao Inde lɔɔsɔ kɔpɔ, Inde lofa kelekëlë, Inde lofaef’iyo kɔpɔ; Inde mbo— Mwaka yao, ino yaatotina;
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

lokele: eoka eba bende bakila bami ba Ngɛla Eyai ebasosendolomo bato wike loasɔ loa limɛsɛli lia batwanelo.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

lokele: Kongo ko itoonga lanu mbo— Itiamwe imɔ liamɔ-li lia boliki, konda lise lina elikamweke’mi eliyai amamwito lanu nda Bɔkɔta wa Sango wami.
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lochwa bɔɛlɛ, iyo lokuswa okakɛ nda löngo loa Elaya.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

lokele: Lamao Yesu loonga lau mbo— Ino yaatotina otokwa se eoka yami la ebocho-bo, loatomökö nde nda Lokasa mbo— Itokuchaka Botingani, limɔ bɛkɔkɔ bitomelesomoko mya.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’ Zechariah 13:7

lokele: Nde mbisa ya litɛmwi liami, itoetel’ino oso konda Ngalilai.
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

lokele: Nde Petelo lomutola lande mbo— Ango batotina bekwa se loasɔ loaɛ, nde inga to imi, ango sinyo.
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Wewe, isoonga laɛ mbo, ko la ebocho-bo, oso ani kɔkɔ ekati lɔkɔkɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ, aɛ nd’atoanganya Imi baanganya basatɔ.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

lokele: Petelo loonga lande mbo— Ambo yengani ndowa amamwito laɛ; nde imi itiangoangany’Aɛ. Baeki batotina loonga nde ko ongoma. Elanga ya Ngetesemane
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

lokele: Iyäkä Yesu amamwito lau nda elela eyetangomu mbo Ngetesemane, Inde loonga la baeki mbo— Yalaka se ono ani Imi itokɛ onamona okasombola.
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

lokele: Inde lotolana la Petelo la bana bambale ba Sebedai, limɔ Inde loakola ndowa l’ikɛnɛnɛ sifi la lɔtɔtɔngɔ.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Botema wami bosowa l’ikɛnɛnɛ ambo showa, tatikalaka eya la lambaka lami.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde lɔkɛ la oso sinyo, Inde loingala la bɔmbɔ nda nyɛlɛ ani atosombola mbo— Sango wami, eyambo lokɔkɔlɔ ongoma, kɔpɔ-ye eeteeleke’mi, tinga to lisangi liami, kangä eliaɛ likelomoko.
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

lokele: Inde loinywa ende baeki, Inde loosh’iyo ani basoingala ilɔ, Inde loonga la Petelo mbo— ¿Ongoma, botilongeke olamba lami ango saa ɛmwito?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

lokele: Lambaka la sombolaka mbo otaɔtɔ nda lisoshela; botema nde bosokimela kongo ko bindo bile la bɔlɛmbu.
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

lokele: Inde lɔkɛ likɛ lia ambale, okasombola mbo— Sango wami, eyambo kɔpɔ-ye angokɔkɔlɔ oeteela’mi sakolo ko imweke yao, ambo lisangi liaɛ likelomoko.
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

lokele: Limɔ Inde loinywa liasi ende baeki, Inde loosh’iyo basoingala tɔlɔ liasi, eoka baiso bau baaka la bolengelenge.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

lokele: Inde lomach’iyo, Inde lɔkɛ lokasombola lisombola lia asatɔ ko la baoi-ao.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

lokele: Limɔ Inde loinywa liasi ende baeki, Inde loonga lau mbo— Ingalaka to, eumaka.… Tɛnɛngɔ, saa esamboya, Wana wa Boto akowambomo nda besamba ya bato abe.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

lokele: Emalaka, tɔɛkɛ. Tɛnɛ, inde oyatowamba’mi ale oko tina. Liwambomu la liundomu lia Yesu
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

lokele: Aaka Inde atoonga, kwaamao Yudasi loya, ɔmɔi wa eba liu la ambale, la amamwito lande ekuke ya bato la chaka la totumbe, ebasokwäkä ende kanga ebieti la biange ya bato.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

lokele: Inde oyawambi to Yesu nd’afäk’iyo ndembe oso, mbo— Boto oyatota’mi et’inde ichou, ambo inde-yo; undesaka’Inde ngwi.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

lokele: Ongoma Yudasi loya kwaamao ende Yesu, inde mbo— Liseeli end’Aɛ, Boekesi; la inde lot’inde ichou.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

lokele: La Yesu loonga lande mbo— Wina, oyeli nd’iye? Lamao iyo loyela Yesu otel’Inde besamba, iyo loundes’Inde ndɔkɛ lande.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

lokele: Futuku, ɔmɔi wa ebayäkä la Yesu lonanola bosamba wɔɔmɔlɔ ambɔtɛ, inde loswa bɔkɔwa wa kanga eyeti, inde lotinya inde litoi.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

lokele: Lamao Yesu loonga lande mbo— Ɔtɛsɛkɛ ambɔtɛ waɛ nda ekoko, eoka batotina ebatounda ambɔtɛ, batosɛɛsɛlɛ ngo ko la ambɔtɛ.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

lokele: ¿Otangi nde mbo itikɔkɔlɛ ndota Sango wami lioi la mbo Inde kotomela’mi ngo ko kwani basilikani bolongela bikuke liu la imbale?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

lokele: ¿Nde eya to ongoma, baoi ba Kasa kokɔchɔmɔ moni, ani Kasa yaongäkä mbo loyaka ngo ko ongoma?
english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

lokele: Limɔ Yesu ko la mbil’ao, loonga l’eba bikuke mbo— Oyeli oyaundesa’mi la chaka la totumbe, kwa mbo yende booni? Lise la lise ayaläkä’mi lanu, nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, aekesiki’mi ino, otiundese’mi.
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

lokele: Nde bitotina-bi bisokelomo mbo Kasa ya Batɔndɔli bikɔchɔmɔkɔ. Lamao baeki batotina lomach’Inde, iyo lolɔmwaka. Yesu oso wa Ikumbɛ sha BaYuda
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

lokele: Limɔ ebaundesäkä Yesu lɔkɛsɛ Inde ende Kayafa, ako kanga ya wange, omao olo asɔngɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ batikasa la biange.
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

lokele: Nde Petelo lotut’Inde esika konda lɔ̈mbɔ loa kanga eyeti, la inde lɔɔtɔ hɔu; inde loyala se omao amamwito la betingani mbo ɛnɛkɛ tuu ya loasɔ.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

lokele: Kanga ebieti la eba ikumbɛ batotina loluka itɔmbɔ mbo boleke Yesu nde batiɛnɛkɛ,
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

lokele: ango bato wike lowanjel’Inde la nanga. Nde ko liili, bambale loyawanjel’Inde,
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

lokele: iyo mbo— Oyo ango’yo loonga mbo— Isokɔkɔlɔ ndoukola Ndako ya Mungu la ndoswa yao liasi nda becho isatɔ.
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

lokele: Limɔ kanga eyeti loemala, inde loonga la Yesu mbo— Otiamutole ango lioi? ¿Tɔtɔmbɔ etosoya l’ebato-ba twende moni?
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

lokele: Nde Yesu loyalaka tau. Lamao kanga eyeti loonga lande mbo— Itotel’Aɛ ekanɔ ko la lina lia Mungu wa lokato mbo oluwesek’iso kwa mbo Aɛ wende ngo Masiya, ako Wana wa Mungu.
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

lokele: Yesu loonga lande mbo— Kwa asoong’aɛ ongoma; itoonga imɔ ko mbo wɛnɛkɛ nde Wana wa Boto elayalaka se nda bosamba w’olome wa Bofoka ani eyaka nda bafita ba use.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

lokele: Limɔ kanga eyeti losalaka bisinda yande, inde mbo— Asosɛɔlɔ Mungu, ¿Tolukeke tɔtɔmbɔ twasi eok’iye? Tɛnɛngɔ, okooka ko kwani asosɛɔlɔ Mungu;
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

lokele: Likomyi lianu liende moni? Iyo lomutola mbo— Engani nde ndoolomo.
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lotwɛlɛ Inde sɔi nda bɔmbɔ, iyo loomak’Inde toku, iyo losekel’Inde mbaka,
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

lokele: iyo mbo— Tatɔndɔɛlɛk’iso, Aɛ ako Masiya, ¿Oyo ndai oyasokuch’Aɛ? Lianganyi lia Petelo
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

lokele: Ayaläkä Petelo lousa nda lɔ̈mbɔ boseka ɔmɔi bosali loya end’inde, inde loonga la Petelo mbo— Aɛ imɔ oyaliki amamwito la Yesu wa Ngalilai.
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

lokele: Nde Petelo loanganya oso wau batotina mbo— Itiluwe elotoong’aɛ.
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

lokele: Akuswäk’inde nda lilɛlɛ lia bome boseka wasi lɔɛnɛ inde, la inde loonga la bato ebayali omao, mbo— Oyo imɔ ayaliki amamwito la Yesu wa Nasalete.
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

lokele: Nde Petelo loanganya imɔ liasi oko la ekanɔ mbo— Itiluwe boto ona, fufo.
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

lokele: Mbisa ya mbile sinyo ebaemali omao loya oyaonga la Petelo mbo— Wewe, l’aɛ imɔ wende ɔmɔi wau, eoka ngɔlu yaɛ imɔ esotombol’aɛ.
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

lokele: Lamao Petelo loakola ndosenda bieo la ndotinyaka ekanɔ mbo— Itiluwe boto ona. Kwaamao kɔkɔ lota lɔkɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈,
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
