lokele: la Petelo loenyela lioi eliaongäkä Yesu lande mbo— Oso ani kɔkɔ ekati lɔkɔ̈kɔ̈lɔ̈kɔ̈, otoanganya’mi banganya basatɔ. Lamao inde lokuswa lousa, inde lolela kɛlɛlikɛlɛli.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

lokele: Aaka bonyanya bososɔswa, kanga bieti la biange ya bato, iyo lɔtɔ ikumbɛ nda loasɔ loa Yesu mbo boolek’Inde.
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

lokele: Akandäk’iyo okanda Yesu, iyo lɔkɛ lande okamach’Inde nda besamba ya Pilato ako Komanda wa Loma. Liwa lia Yudasi
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

lokele: Limɔ Yudasi oyawambäkä Inde, ɛnɛ̈k’inde mbo Yesu afomuku nde se, inde lokalangana, inde lokainola pata kama isatɔ ende kanga ebieti la biange,
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

lokele: inde mbo— Isotwanelo ko ndowamba bakila ba oyati la loasɔ. Nde iyo mbo— ¿Loni to loasɔ loasu-lo? Aɛ angɛnɛ komyaka loao.
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

lokele: Lamao inde lofifa bieto se konda kuku ya Ndakɔ ya Mungu, inde lokuswa, inde lɔkɛ okakwa linga.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

lokele: Nde kanga ebieti lɔɔsɔ bieto, iyo mbo— Lotiengane la Bikela ndota yao nda sanduku ya lifaefi, eoka ende bolïli wa bakila.
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lɔɔtɔ ikumbɛ sha loasɔ, iyo losomba elanga ya bakuki ba tei ya tɔlɔngɔ la bieto ina, elanga losɛɛlɔmɔ eombelo ya bɛɛnda.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

lokele: Eokao elanga ena lotangomo mbo Elanga ya Bakila, ko nd’eweuse.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

lokele: Lona eloaongäkä Yelemaya ewa Bɔtɔndɔli loakɔchɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ mbo— Baɔsɔ̈kɔ̈ pata kama isatɔ, bolïli wa Inde oyatinyomökö loketi ko la bana ba Isalaeli,
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah 27:9 the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

lokele: La iyo losomba la bieto-ao elanga ya bakuki ba tei, Kwa aongäkä Ngɛnɛ eonga lami. Yesu la Pilato
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.” Zechariah 11:12-13

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loemala oso wa Komanda; la Komanda lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Aɛ wende Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda? Yesu loonga lande mbo— Aɛ nd’aongi ongoma.
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

lokele: Awanjelomökö Inde la kanga ebieti la biange, Inde angomutola ango lioi.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

lokele: Limɔ Pilato loonga lande mbo— Otioke likama lia njasɔ ebisowanjel’iyo laɛ?
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

lokele: Nde Yesu atimutole lioi nda loasɔ ango lɔmɔi, ongoma Komanda lomwaala finɛ.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

lokele: Nda lise lia Elambɔ, Komanda ayaläkä la boyaeli wofaikoela bato, ɔmɔi wa ebakandomu kwa asangäk’iyo.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

lokele: Bayaläkä nde la boto wa lokuku lofi nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ako Balaba.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

lokele: Eokao, asɔngɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ iyo oso wande, Pilato lofela bato mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nde mbo ifaikoelek’ino ndai to? ¿Kwa Balaba kwa Yesu oyasotomo Masiya?
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

lokele: eoka Pilato aluwi nde mbo basoesha Yesu nda likomyi ko l’eoka ya lisiela kongo.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

lokele: Ayaläkä Pilato nda kɛka ya likomonyi, wali wande lotomel’inde wɛndi mbo— Oyalëke la loasɔ la boto ona oyengani, eoka yɛniki tale finɛ nda saki louse ko loasɔ loande.
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

lokele: Kongo ko kanga ebieti la biange, iyo lofumbesa ekuke ya bato mbo bafeleke Pilato ateke Balaba se la mbo basɛɛsɛlɛsɛkɛ Yesu.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

lokele: Limɔ Komanda lofel’iyo liasi mbo— Boni boto wau yaambale oyalɛmb’ino mbo ifaikoelek’inde eoka yanu? Iyo mbo— Kangä Balaba.
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

lokele: Lamao Pilato mbo— ¿Ikeleke to iye la Yesu oyasotomo lina liko Masiya? Iyo yaatotina mbo— Aolomoko nda lieka.
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

lokele: Komanda mbo— ¿Eoka iye? ¿Boni obe bosokel’inde? Kongo ko iyo loanjanja liasi imɔ mbo— Aolomoko nda lieka.
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

lokele: Lamao ɛnɛ̈kɛ̈ Pilato mbo atialongele, kangä mbo bato basambokela etondo, inde lɔɔsɔ balia, inde losoola bangasa bande oso wa baiso b’eba ekuke, inde mbo— Iti’mɔ la loasɔ loa bakila ba boto-yo oyengani, ino ɔsɔkɔ to loao.
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

lokele: Bato batotina loaola mbo— Bakila bande baomaneke oko end’iso la ende bana basu.
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

lokele: Limɔ inde lofaikoel’iyo Balaba, la aomakomökö Yesu fimbo, inde lofaef’iyo Inde mbo aolomoko nda lieka.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

lokele: Lamao basilikani ba Komanda lɔkɛ la Yesu konda lɔ̈mbɔ loau, la iyo losɔngɔmɛsɛ botukä bototi wau oso wande,
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

lokele: iyo lowatola bisinda yande, iyo lowates’Inde esinda etelu;
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

lokele: iyo lotaka likala lia kɛ̈kɛ̈, la iyo lotel’Inde liao nda botö, iyo lɔsɛlɛ isosola nda lingasa lia olome; iyo loswel’Inde balui se la iyo lotak’Inde kömbö mbo— Liseeli, Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda-o.
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

lokele: Iyo lochwɛlɛ Inde sɔi, limɔ iyo lɔnɔkɔlɔ isosola, iyo loomaka Inde nda botö la shao.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

lokele: Limɔ asiläk’iyo ndot’Inde kungutu, iyo losokoel’Inde esinda etelu, iyo lowates’Inde esinda yande angɛnɛ, limɔ iyo lɔkɛs’Inde okaol’Inde nda lieka. Liwa nda Lieka
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

lokele: Akuswäk’iyo nda okenge, iyo lotowana la boto wa Kulene, lina liande liko Simona, iyo lotoles’inde lieka.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

lokele: Iyäk’iyo nda elela eyatangomoko mbo Ngolongota (litina mbo Longö-loa-otö)
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

lokele: iyo lofaef’Inde bänä babuyani la lisoo lia shungu, alɛtɛk’Inde bao, nde atikulie ndomwa.
english: they gave him sour wine 27:34 to drink mixed with gall. 27:34 When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

lokele: Asiläk’iyo ndoanyames’Inde nda lieka limɔ iyo lokaana bisinda yande ko ndota ngongo nda likao,
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots, 27:35

lokele: lamao iyo loyalaka se tɛɛ ndotingana lande omao.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

lokele: Olikolo lia botö wande iyo lota liwanjeli liau owanjel’Inde, mbo— Oyo ende Yesu, Bɔkɔta wa BaYuda.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

lokele: Limɔ ba beoni bambale loanyomo nda baeka bau lisanga, amamwito lande, ɔmɔi nda osamba wa olome la ɔmɔi nda osamba wa wali.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

lokele: Ebetäkä losungakel’Inde, iyo lofilingekel’Inde betö,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

lokele: iyo mbo— Aɛ, oyatomelesa Ndakɔ ya Mungu koswa liasi ko la becho isatɔ, uwesaka lokomba loaɛ angɛnɛ. Eyambo wende Wana wa Mungu, sokwaka nda lieka.
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

lokele: Imɔ ko kanga ebieti amamwito la Batikasa la biange lolimbokol’Inde, mbo—
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, 27:41 and the elders, said,

lokele: Auwekesäkä basi, atikɔkɔlɛ ndouwesa lokomba loande angɛnɛ. Ende Bokɔta wa Isalaele asokweke nda lieka kwani, limɔ iso koimel’Inde.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

lokele: Asolendelo Mungu; ko Mungu ɛlɛmb’Inde, auwesek’Inde ko kwani, eoka Inde angɛnɛ nd’aongäkä mbo— Yende Wana wa Mungu.
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

lokele: L’eba beoni imɔ ebaanyemesomökö nda baeka lande, iyo lolimbol’Inde.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

lokele: Ayäkä buse ifitika, lilima lokwa nda yese etotina konda lilongolongo,
english: Now from the sixth hour 27:45 there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour. 27:45

lokele: Lamao tina la lilongolongo Yesu lota limiki lifi, Inde mbo— Eli, Eli, lama sabakatani? lile mbo— ¿Mungu wami, Mungu wami, moni osomachaka’mi booi?
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima 27:46 sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?” Psalms 22:1

lokele: Bamɔi ebemaläkä omao, iyo looka, iyo mbo— Inde nd’asota Eliya lioi.
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

lokele: Lisasaya ɔmɔi wau lokwa mangu okɔsɔ lilamba, inde lɔfɔɛsɛ liao nda bänä, inde lota liao nda ifende, inde lofa Yesu amweke.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

lokele: Nde ebamɔi loonga mbo— Macha, twɛnɛkɛ ango Eliya ataya oyauwes’Inde.
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

lokele: Lamao Yesu lota limiki lifi liasi, Inde lokusola luli nda liwa.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

lokele: Kwaamao, esinda ya Ndakɔ ya Mungu losalya yaki imbale ko likolo ko se, la nyɛlɛ lotukatuka la batalɛ loachacha;
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

lokele: sai loliokolomo la belyo wike ya bato ebengani ebakwäkä ilɔ sha liwa, iyo lokuswakuswaka,
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

lokele: iyo losekwa nda sai mbisa ya batɛmwɛlɔ ba Yesu, iyo lɔɔtɔkɔ nda Bokenge Botanu, iyo lɔɛnɛlɛ ende bato wike.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

lokele: Enɛkɛ Komanda wa basilikani la bato ebatinganaka la Yesu amamwito lande, ɛnɛ̈k’iyo lotukeso loa nyɛlɛ la tolombo etwakelomökö, inde lau lomwaala la bɔwa, iyo mbo— Wewe, Oyo aiki nde Wana wa Mungu.
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

lokele: Batomali nde wike baaka esika sumbu otichaka elokelomu, batomali ana batutäkä Yesu, basekweläkä Ngalilai okakukia Inde,
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

lokele: bamɔi baaka nde Malia wa Mangandala, la Malia nyango wa Yakobo la Yose, la nyango wa bana ba Sebedayo. Liombomu lia Yesu
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

lokele: Iyäkä nde buse litele, boto wa lifoka oyasekwäkä nda Alimatayo, lina liande liko Yosefa, oyaaka imɔ boeki wa Yesu, inde lɔkɛ ende Pilato okaömba bolyo wa Yesu.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

lokele: Limɔ Pilato loonga mbo bolyo bofomoko ende inde.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

lokele: La Yosefa lɔɔsɔ bolyo, inde lolingela wao la bisinda bifufu,
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

lokele: inde loingesa wao nda losai loyai, eloande angɛnɛ eloafuwäk’inde nda batalɛ, inde loundukokola litalɛ lifi liolinja ɛɔtɛlɔ ya losai, limɔ inde lɔkɛ,
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

lokele: nde Malia wa Mangandala la Malia oyɔmɔi baaka omao, bayaläkä se tina la losai.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ, nda lise elisotüta elia lokomyo (loa Yenga), kanga ebieti la BaFalusi lokatowana ende Pilato,
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

lokele: iyo loonga lande mbo— Ngɛnɛ, tokoenyela mbo e-boto wa bolimbakeli-bo akoyali Inde la liwawi, aongäkä mbo— Mbisa ya becho isatɔ yekuswaka liasi.
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

lokele: Eokao, taka sumbu ndola mbo losai lɔsɔlɔnɛsɔmɔkɔ sɔlɛ̈ konda bocho w’isatɔ, mbo baeki bande batakɛ okainda Inde limɔ bataonga la bato mbo asokuswa nda liwa; ongoma ikitakitä sha liili sitolonga esha oso la bolimbake.
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

lokele: Pilato loonga lau mbo— Wende la bato bolambaka, kɛndɛ okasɔlɔnɛsɛ losai sɔlɛ kwa asokɔkɔlɔ ino.
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

lokele: Iyo lotangwa okasɔlonɛsɛ losai, iyo lokɔkɔmɛsɛ litalɛ la chapa, la iyo lotika basilikani bolambaka loao.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

lokele: Asamboeta lise lia osambale (Yenga ya BaYuda), ani yömbe ya lise lia oso lia yenga esokangwa, Malia wa Mangandala la Malia oyɔmɔi, iyo loya oyɛnɛ losai.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

lokele: Futuku, nyɛlɛ lotukatuka likama, bokitomo wa Ngɛnɛ Mungu losulwa se nda Use, inde loyaundukola litalɛ, inde loyala se nda liao.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

lokele: Inde lɔɛnɛlɛ kwa ibalibali la bisinda yande bifufwi kwa basasɛ ba mbula;
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

lokele: basilikani ebalambi loilikima la bɔwa, iyo lolewa kwa ebasowa.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

lokele: Nde bokitomo loonga la batomali mbo— Owangëke, ino batomali, eoka iluwi nde mbo osolukä Yesu oyaolomu nda lieka;
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

lokele: ati’mɔ ono, eoka asotɛmwa kwa aongäk’Inde. Yauku oyɛnɛ elela eyeingael’Inde.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

lokele: Limɔ kɛndɛkɛ mangu okakambesa baeki bande mbo asotɛmwa nda liwa, la kwanikwani asɔkɛ oso wanu konda Ngalilai, wɛnɛkɛ nd’Inde omao. Tɛnɛ, isokambesa nd’ino.
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

lokele: Lamao batomali losekwa lisasaya nda losai la bɔwa la linɛngina lifi; iyo lokwaka mangu okakɛsɛlɛ baeki bande wɛndi.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

lokele: Limɔ futuku, Yesu lotowana lau nda mboka, Inde mbo— Saelaka betema. Iyo loyel’Inde oyakusamel’Inde batindi, iyo losemol’Inde.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loonga lau mbo— Owangëke, kɛndɛkɛ okakambesa bitungani yami mbo batetaka konda Ngalilai, bɛnɛkɛ nde’mi omao.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers 28:10 that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

lokele: Aɛkɛ batomali ongoma, basilikani bamɔi (ebalambiki losai) loiya nda bokenge (wa Yelusaleme) iyo lokambesa kanga ebieti bitotina ebikelomuku.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

lokele: Asɔngɔmɔ̈kɔ̈ iyo la biange imɔ, aɔtɔk’iyo ikumbɛ, iyo lofaefa basilikani bieto ya likama,
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

lokele: iyo mbo— Ongaka mbo baeki bande bayiki la ocho ndoinda Inde ani toingali tɔlɔ.
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

lokele: Eyambo loasɔ loiya nda batoi ba Komanda, iso nd’atoɔngɔl’inde mbo ino otɛnɛ efembi nda loasɔ-lo.
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

lokele: Iyo lɔɔsɔ to bieto, iyo lokela kwa akambesomu iyo; eokao lioi-li lisookana ende BaYuda konda eweuse. Baoi ba Liili ba Yesu ende Baeki
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

lokele: Nde baeki liu la ɔmɔi lɔkakɛ konda Ngalilai, nda löngo eyakuliaka Yesu lau oso.
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

lokele: Enɛ̈k’iyo wɛnɛ Yesu, iyo losemol’Inde, kongo ko bamɔi lota fee.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

lokele: Limɔ Yesu loya tina, Inde loonga lau mbo— Isofomo tososha tototina la nda Use la ono se.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

lokele: Eokao kɛndɛkɛ okasɛlɛ bato nda wenda bototina baeki bami, lufiak’iyo ko nda lina lia Sango la Wana la Bolimo Botanu,
english: Go 28:19 and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

lokele: ani otoekekes’iyo ndolitesa bitotina eyateläkä’mi otel’ino bikela. Tɛnɛ, Imi yende ngo ko amamwito lanu, lise la lise konda basilelo ba wenda.
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
